ko.title: 이자 청구서가 날아오다: 워싱턴의 부채 상환액이 왜 가장 큰 예산 항목들과 경쟁하게 되었나

segments.src: For decades, interest on the national debt was a line item most Americans never thought about.
segments.tr: 수십 년 동안 국가 부채에 대한 이자는 대부분의 미국인이 생각조차 하지 않는 항목이었습니다.

segments.src: That is changing.
segments.tr: 이제는 상황이 바뀌고 있습니다.

segments.src: Net interest, the amount the federal government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, has climbed to roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates from the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Treasury Department.
segments.tr: 순이자(net interest), 즉 연방 정부가 벌어들이는 이자를 뺀 차입금에 대해 지불하는 금액은 최근 의회예산국(CBO)과 재무부의 추산에 따르면 연간 약 1조 달러까지 치솟았습니다.

segments.src: That puts it in the same league as Medicare and national defense, and well above many programs that dominate budget debates.
segments.tr: 이는 메디케어(Medicare) 및 국방비와 같은 수준이며, 예산 논쟁을 지배하는 많은 프로그램보다 훨씬 높은 금액입니다.

segments.src: This explainer walks through why the bill has grown, how it works, and what it could mean for budget negotiations, Treasury yields and long-term fiscal choices.
segments.tr: 이 설명 자료에서는 이 청구서가 왜 증가했는지, 어떻게 작동하는지, 그리고 이것이 예산 협상, 재무부 수익률 및 장기적인 재정 선택에 어떤 의미를 가질 수 있는지 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: ## What "interest on the debt" actually means
segments.tr: ## "부채에 대한 이자"의 실제 의미

segments.src: The federal government borrows by selling Treasury securities: short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: 연방 정부는 단기 재정증권, 중기 채권, 장기 채권과 같은 재무부 증권을 매각하여 자금을 차입합니다.

segments.src: Investors, including pension funds, banks, foreign governments, mutual funds and individuals, buy them and receive interest payments.
segments.tr: 연기금, 은행, 외국 정부, 뮤추얼 펀드 및 개인을 포함한 투자자들은 이를 매입하고 이자를 받습니다.

segments.src: Two figures are often mixed up:
segments.tr: 두 가지 수치가 종종 혼동됩니다:

segments.src: - **Gross interest** is everything the government pays on all outstanding debt, including debt held by other parts of the government, such as trust funds.
segments.tr: - **총이자(Gross interest)**는 신탁 기금과 같이 정부의 다른 부문이 보유한 부채를 포함하여 정부가 모든 미상환 부채에 대해 지불하는 모든 금액입니다.

segments.src: - **Net interest** subtracts interest the government receives, and it is the figure most budget analysts track because it reflects the real claim on the budget.
segments.tr: - **순이자(Net interest)**는 정부가 받는 이자를 뺀 금액이며, 예산에 대한 실질적인 부담을 반영하기 때문에 대부분의 예산 분석가가 추적하는 수치입니다.

segments.src: Either way, the number has grown quickly in recent years, both in dollars and as a share of the economy and of federal spending.
segments.tr: 어느 쪽이든, 이 수치는 최근 몇 년 동안 달러 기준뿐만 아니라 경제 및 연방 지출에서 차지하는 비중 면에서도 빠르게 증가했습니다.

segments.src: ## Two forces behind the rise
segments.tr: ## 상승의 이면에 있는 두 가지 요인

segments.src: ### 1. A bigger pile of debt
segments.tr: ### 1. 더 커진 부채 규모

segments.src: Federal debt held by the public has grown substantially over the past two decades.
segments.tr: 대중이 보유한 연방 부채는 지난 20년 동안 상당히 증가했습니다.

segments.src: Recessions, the 2020 pandemic response, tax changes and the rising costs of an aging population have all contributed.
segments.tr: 경기 침체, 2020년 팬데믹 대응, 세제 변화, 고령화 인구로 인한 비용 상승 등이 모두 원인이 되었습니다.

segments.src: Because the government has generally run annual deficits, new borrowing keeps adding to the base on which interest is charged.
segments.tr: 정부가 일반적으로 연간 적자를 기록하고 있기 때문에, 새로운 차입은 이자가 부과되는 기반을 계속해서 늘리고 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher interest rates
segments.tr: ### 2. 더 높은 금리

segments.src: For much of the 2010s, rates were historically low, so a large debt was relatively cheap to carry.
segments.tr: 2010년대 대부분 동안 금리는 역사적으로 낮았기 때문에 거대한 부채를 유지하는 비용은 상대적으로 저렴했습니다.

segments.src: When inflation surged in 2022, the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate sharply, and yields across the Treasury market rose with it.
segments.tr: 2022년 인플레이션이 급등했을 때 연방준비제도(Fed)는 기준 금리를 급격히 인상했고, 이에 따라 재무부 시장 전반의 수익률도 상승했습니다.

segments.src: The effect does not show up all at once.
segments.tr: 그 효과가 한꺼번에 나타나지는 않습니다.

segments.src: The Treasury continually refinances debt as older securities mature.
segments.tr: 재무부는 오래된 증권이 만기가 되면 지속적으로 부채를 차환(refinance)합니다.

segments.src: A bond issued at a low rate years ago is eventually replaced by one at today's higher rate, so the average rate on the whole debt drifts upward gradually.
segments.tr: 몇 년 전 낮은 금리로 발행된 채권은 결국 오늘날의 더 높은 금리로 발행된 채권으로 대체되므로, 전체 부채에 대한 평균 금리는 점진적으로 상승합니다.

segments.src: This is why interest costs can keep rising even after rates stop climbing.
segments.tr: 이것이 금리 인상이 멈춘 후에도 이자 비용이 계속 상승할 수 있는 이유입니다.

segments.src: Short-term bills are especially sensitive.
segments.tr: 단기 재정증권은 특히 민감합니다.

segments.src: They roll over frequently, so changes in the Fed's policy rate feed through to the government's costs within months.
segments.tr: 이들은 자주 롤오버(만기 연장)되기 때문에 연준의 정책 금리 변화가 몇 달 안에 정부 비용에 반영됩니다.

segments.src: ## How the numbers compare
segments.tr: ## 수치 비교

segments.src: Net interest now exceeds what the government spends on national defense in several recent fiscal-year estimates, and it rivals or surpasses Medicaid and many other major categories.
segments.tr: 최근 몇몇 회계연도 추정치에서 순이자는 정부가 국방에 지출하는 금액을 초과했으며, 메디케이드(Medicaid) 및 기타 여러 주요 범주와 비슷하거나 그보다 많습니다.

segments.src: The largest items, Social Security and Medicare, remain bigger.
segments.tr: 가장 큰 항목인 사회보장제도(Social Security)와 메디케어(Medicare)는 여전히 더 큽니다.

segments.src: Still, interest differs from those programs in one important way: it is not a service Americans receive.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 이자는 그러한 프로그램들과 한 가지 중요한 점에서 다릅니다. 즉, 미국인이 받는 서비스가 아니라는 점입니다.

segments.src: It is the cost of past borrowing, and it cannot be cut through ordinary program reforms.
segments.tr: 이는 과거 차입에 대한 비용이며, 일반적인 프로그램 개혁을 통해서는 삭감할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: Exact rankings vary by year and by how spending is categorized, so it is worth checking the latest CBO and Treasury data when you read a headline comparison.
segments.tr: 정확한 순위는 연도별로, 그리고 지출이 분류되는 방식에 따라 다르므로 헤드라인 비교를 읽을 때는 최신 CBO 및 재무부 데이터를 확인하는 것이 좋습니다.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for budget fights
segments.tr: ## 예산 싸움에서 중요한 이유

segments.src: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.
segments.tr: **운신의 폭이 좁아짐.** 이자에 지출되는 모든 달러는 도로, 연구, 국방, 의료 또는 세금 감면에 사용할 수 없는 돈이며, 더 많은 차입으로 조달하지 않는 한 그렇습니다.

segments.src: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.
segments.tr: 연간 지출 법안을 협상하는 의원들은 전체 예산 대비 재량 지출 자금의 규모가 점점 작아지는 상황에서 일하고 있습니다.

segments.src: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.
segments.tr: **피드백 루프.** 더 높은 이자 비용은 적자를 확대하고, 이는 더 많은 차입을 필요로 하며, 이는 미래의 이자 비용을 증가시킵니다.

segments.src: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 이를 복리 효과라고 설명하기도 합니다.

segments.src: It is not inevitable, but it becomes harder to reverse as the debt grows relative to the economy.
segments.tr: 이는 불가피한 것은 아니지만, 경제 규모 대비 부채가 커질수록 되돌리기가 더 어려워집니다.

segments.src: **Political disagreement over the fix.** Analysts and policymakers differ on the response.
segments.tr: **해결책에 대한 정치적 불일치.** 분석가와 정책 입안자들은 대응 방식에 대해 의견이 다릅니다.

segments.src: Some emphasize spending restraint, others favor raising revenue, and others stress faster economic growth.
segments.tr: 일부는 지출 억제를 강조하고, 다른 일부는 세수 증대를 선호하며, 또 다른 일부는 더 빠른 경제 성장을 강조합니다.

segments.src: Most nonpartisan analysts agree on one point: the arithmetic of rising interest costs makes the choices harder the longer they are postponed.
segments.tr: 대부분의 초당파적 분석가들은 한 가지 점에 동의합니다. 즉, 이자 비용 상승이라는 산수는 결정을 미룰수록 더 어렵게 만든다는 것입니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for Treasury yields
segments.tr: ## 재무부 수익률에 미치는 의미

segments.src: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.
segments.tr: 재무부 수익률은 시장이 정부에 대출해 줄 때 설정하는 가격입니다.

segments.src: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.
segments.tr: 이는 인플레이션, 연준 정책, 경제 성장 및 새로운 부채 공급에 대한 기대에 반응합니다.

segments.src: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.
segments.tr: 정부가 대량의 증권을 매각해야 할 때, 투자자들은 특히 장기 만기 증권에 대해 공급을 흡수하기 위해 더 높은 수익률을 요구할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.
segments.tr: 재정 정책에 대한 논쟁, 부채 한도 대치 상황 및 신용 등급 결정도 시장을 움직일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.
segments.tr: 수익률이 높아지면 결과적으로 정부의 미래 차입 비용이 상승하고, 주택 담보 대출, 자동차 대출 및 기업 부채 금리에도 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.
segments.tr: 수익률은 여러 요인에 동시에 영향을 받기 때문에 단일 요인의 효과를 분리하기는 어렵습니다.

segments.src: Treat any single-cause explanation of a yield move with caution.
segments.tr: 수익률 변동에 대한 단일 원인 설명은 주의해서 받아들이십시오.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services
segments.tr: ## 미래의 세금과 서비스에 미칠 수 있는 의미

segments.src: Interest costs do not directly set tax policy, but they shape the options.
segments.tr: 이자 비용이 직접적으로 세금 정책을 결정하지는 않지만, 선택의 폭을 형성합니다.

segments.src: In broad terms, a government facing growing interest obligations can:
segments.tr: 광범위하게 말해서, 증가하는 이자 의무에 직면한 정부는 다음과 같은 조치를 취할 수 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. Raise revenue through taxes or fees.
segments.tr: 1. 세금이나 수수료를 통해 세수를 늘린다.

segments.src: 2. Slow the growth of other spending.
segments.tr: 2. 다른 지출의 증가를 늦춘다.

segments.src: 3. Borrow more and accept higher interest costs.
segments.tr: 3. 더 많이 차입하고 더 높은 이자 비용을 감수한다.

segments.src: 4. Rely on stronger economic growth to expand the tax base.
segments.tr: 4. 더 강력한 경제 성장에 의존하여 세원을 확대한다.

segments.src: In practice, governments usually use some mix.
segments.tr: 실제로 정부는 보통 이 중 일부를 혼합하여 사용합니다.

segments.src: Which mix to choose is a political decision, and reasonable people disagree.
segments.tr: 어떤 조합을 선택할지는 정치적 결정이며, 합리적인 사람들 사이에서도 의견이 갈립니다.

segments.src: What the numbers do show is that deferring the decision does not remove the cost.
segments.tr: 수치가 보여주는 것은 결정을 미루는 것이 비용을 없애지는 않는다는 점입니다.

segments.src: ## Key takeaways
segments.tr: ## 핵심 요약

segments.src: - Net interest has become one of the largest federal budget categories, at roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates.
segments.tr: - 순이자는 최근 추산에 따르면 연간 약 1조 달러로, 가장 큰 연방 예산 범주 중 하나가 되었습니다.

segments.src: - The increase comes from both a larger debt and higher interest rates, with refinancing spreading the effect over several years.
segments.tr: - 이러한 증가는 더 커진 부채와 더 높은 금리 모두에서 비롯되며, 차환을 통해 그 효과가 수년에 걸쳐 확산됩니다.

segments.src: - Interest spending is less flexible than most other parts of the budget.
segments.tr: - 이자 지출은 예산의 다른 대부분 부분보다 유연성이 떨어집니다.

segments.src: - Treasury yields, deficits and fiscal debates influence one another.
segments.tr: - 재무부 수익률, 적자 및 재정 논쟁은 서로에게 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: - Future tax and spending choices will be made against this backdrop.
segments.tr: - 미래의 세금 및 지출 선택은 이러한 배경 속에서 이루어질 것입니다.

segments.src: ## Where to find reliable data
segments.tr: ## 신뢰할 수 있는 데이터를 찾는 곳

segments.src: For current figures, consult primary sources: the Congressional Budget Office's budget and economic outlook, the Treasury Department's Monthly Treasury Statement and Fiscal Data site, and the Office of Management and Budget.
segments.tr: 현재 수치를 확인하려면 의회예산국의 예산 및 경제 전망, 재무부의 월간 재무 보고서 및 재정 데이터 사이트, 그리고 관리예산실과 같은 1차 출처를 참조하십시오.

segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 및 교육 목적으로만 제공됩니다.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice, and figures are approximate and may change as new data is released.*
segments.tr: 이는 투자, 세금 또는 재정 조언이 아니며, 수치는 대략적인 것이며 새로운 데이터가 발표됨에 따라 변경될 수 있습니다.*

segments.src: ## Why it matters for budget fights
segments.tr: ## Why it matters for budget fights

segments.src: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.
segments.tr: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.

segments.src: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.
segments.tr: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.

segments.src: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.
segments.tr: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.

segments.src: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.

segments.src: It is not inevitable, but it becomes harder to reverse as the debt grows relative to the economy.

segments.src: **Political disagreement over the fix.** Analysts and policymakers differ on the response.

segments.src: Some emphasize spending restraint, others favor raising revenue, and others stress faster economic growth.

segments.src: Most nonpartisan analysts agree on one point: the arithmetic of rising interest costs makes the choices harder the longer they are postponed.

segments.src: ## What it means for Treasury yields
segments.tr: ## What it means for Treasury yields

segments.src: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.
segments.tr: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.

segments.src: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.
segments.tr: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.

segments.src: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.
segments.tr: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.

segments.src: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.
segments.tr: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.

segments.src: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.
segments.tr: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.

segments.src: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.
segments.tr: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.

segments.src: Treat any single-cause explanation of a yield move with caution.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services
segments.tr: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services

segments.src: Interest costs do not directly set tax policy, but they shape the options.

segments.tr: In broad terms, a government facing growing interest obligations can:

segments.tr: 4. Rely on stronger economic growth to expand the tax base.

hi.title: ब्याज का बिल चुकाने का समय आ गया है: वाशिंगटन का ऋण भुगतान अब उसके सबसे बड़े बजट मदों के बराबर क्यों है

segments.src: For decades, interest on the national debt was a line item most Americans never thought about.
segments.tr: दशकों तक, राष्ट्रीय ऋण पर ब्याज एक ऐसी मद थी जिसके बारे में अधिकांश अमेरिकी कभी नहीं सोचते थे।

segments.src: That is changing.
segments.tr: यह बदल रहा है।

segments.src: Net interest, the amount the federal government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, has climbed to roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates from the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Treasury Department.
segments.tr: शुद्ध ब्याज, यानी संघीय सरकार द्वारा अर्जित ब्याज को घटाने के बाद उसके उधार पर चुकाया जाने वाला भुगतान, कांग्रेसनल बजट ऑफिस (CBO) और ट्रेजरी विभाग के हालिया अनुमानों के अनुसार प्रति वर्ष लगभग $1 ट्रिलियन तक पहुंच गया है।

segments.src: That puts it in the same league as Medicare and national defense, and well above many programs that dominate budget debates.
segments.tr: यह इसे मेडिकेयर और राष्ट्रीय रक्षा के बराबर श्रेणी में रखता है, और बजट बहसों में हावी रहने वाले कई कार्यक्रमों से काफी ऊपर है।

segments.src: This explainer walks through why the bill has grown, how it works, and what it could mean for budget negotiations, Treasury yields and long-term fiscal choices.
segments.tr: यह व्याख्यात्मक लेख बताता है कि यह बिल क्यों बढ़ा है, यह कैसे काम करता है, और बजट वार्ता, ट्रेजरी यील्ड और दीर्घकालिक राजकोषीय विकल्पों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## What "interest on the debt" actually means
segments.tr: ## "ऋण पर ब्याज" का वास्तव में क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: The federal government borrows by selling Treasury securities: short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: संघीय सरकार ट्रेजरी प्रतिभूतियां बेचकर उधार लेती है: अल्पकालिक बिल, मध्यम अवधि के नोट और दीर्घकालिक बॉन्ड।

segments.src: Investors, including pension funds, banks, foreign governments, mutual funds and individuals, buy them and receive interest payments.
segments.tr: निवेशक, जिनमें पेंशन फंड, बैंक, विदेशी सरकारें, म्यूचुअल फंड और व्यक्ति शामिल हैं, इन्हें खरीदते हैं और ब्याज भुगतान प्राप्त करते हैं।

segments.src: Two figures are often mixed up:
segments.tr: दो आंकड़ों को अक्सर मिला दिया जाता है:

segments.src: - **Gross interest** is everything the government pays on all outstanding debt, including debt held by other parts of the government, such as trust funds.
segments.tr: - **सकल ब्याज** वह सब कुछ है जो सरकार सभी बकाया ऋणों पर चुकाती है, जिसमें सरकार के अन्य हिस्सों, जैसे ट्रस्ट फंड, द्वारा रखा गया ऋण भी शामिल है।

segments.src: - **Net interest** subtracts interest the government receives, and it is the figure most budget analysts track because it reflects the real claim on the budget.
segments.tr: - **शुद्ध ब्याज** सरकार द्वारा प्राप्त ब्याज को घटा देता है, और यह वह आंकड़ा है जिसे अधिकांश बजट विश्लेषक ट्रैक करते हैं क्योंकि यह बजट पर वास्तविक दावे को दर्शाता है।

segments.src: Either way, the number has grown quickly in recent years, both in dollars and as a share of the economy and of federal spending.
segments.tr: किसी भी तरह से, यह संख्या हाल के वर्षों में तेजी से बढ़ी है, डॉलर में भी और अर्थव्यवस्था तथा संघीय खर्च के हिस्से के रूप में भी।

segments.src: ## Two forces behind the rise
segments.tr: ## वृद्धि के पीछे दो ताकतें

segments.src: ### 1. A bigger pile of debt
segments.tr: ### 1. ऋण का बड़ा ढेर

segments.src: Federal debt held by the public has grown substantially over the past two decades.
segments.tr: जनता के पास मौजूद संघीय ऋण पिछले दो दशकों में काफी बढ़ गया है।

segments.src: Recessions, the 2020 pandemic response, tax changes and the rising costs of an aging population have all contributed.
segments.tr: मंदी, 2020 की महामारी की प्रतिक्रिया, कर परिवर्तन और बढ़ती उम्र की आबादी की बढ़ती लागत ने इसमें योगदान दिया है।

segments.src: Because the government has generally run annual deficits, new borrowing keeps adding to the base on which interest is charged.
segments.tr: चूंकि सरकार ने आम तौर पर वार्षिक घाटा चलाया है, इसलिए नया उधार उस आधार को बढ़ाता रहता है जिस पर ब्याज लिया जाता है।

segments.src: ### 2. Higher interest rates
segments.tr: ### 2. उच्च ब्याज दरें

segments.src: For much of the 2010s, rates were historically low, so a large debt was relatively cheap to carry.
segments.tr: 2010 के दशक के अधिकांश समय में, दरें ऐतिहासिक रूप से कम थीं, इसलिए बड़ा ऋण उठाना अपेक्षाकृत सस्ता था।

segments.src: When inflation surged in 2022, the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate sharply, and yields across the Treasury market rose with it.
segments.tr: जब 2022 में मुद्रास्फीति बढ़ी, तो फेडरल रिजर्व ने अपनी बेंचमार्क दर में तेजी से वृद्धि की, और इसके साथ ही ट्रेजरी बाजार में यील्ड भी बढ़ गई।

segments.src: The effect does not show up all at once.
segments.tr: इसका प्रभाव एक बार में नहीं दिखता है।

segments.src: The Treasury continually refinances debt as older securities mature.
segments.tr: ट्रेजरी पुरानी प्रतिभूतियों के परिपक्व होने पर लगातार ऋण को पुनर्वित्त (refinance) करती है।

segments.src: A bond issued at a low rate years ago is eventually replaced by one at today's higher rate, so the average rate on the whole debt drifts upward gradually.
segments.tr: वर्षों पहले कम दर पर जारी किया गया बॉन्ड अंततः आज की उच्च दर वाले बॉन्ड द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित हो जाता है, इसलिए पूरे ऋण पर औसत दर धीरे-धीरे ऊपर की ओर बढ़ती है।

segments.src: This is why interest costs can keep rising even after rates stop climbing.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि दरों के बढ़ना बंद होने के बाद भी ब्याज लागत बढ़ती रह सकती है।

segments.src: Short-term bills are especially sensitive.
segments.tr: अल्पकालिक बिल विशेष रूप से संवेदनशील होते हैं।

segments.src: They roll over frequently, so changes in the Fed's policy rate feed through to the government's costs within months.
segments.tr: वे अक्सर रोल ओवर होते हैं, इसलिए फेड की नीति दर में बदलाव कुछ ही महीनों के भीतर सरकार की लागतों में परिलक्षित हो जाते हैं।

segments.src: ## How the numbers compare
segments.tr: ## आंकड़ों की तुलना कैसे करें

segments.src: Net interest now exceeds what the government spends on national defense in several recent fiscal-year estimates, and it rivals or surpasses Medicaid and many other major categories.
segments.tr: शुद्ध ब्याज अब कई हालिया वित्तीय वर्ष के अनुमानों में राष्ट्रीय रक्षा पर सरकार द्वारा खर्च की जाने वाली राशि से अधिक है, और यह मेडिकेड और कई अन्य प्रमुख श्रेणियों के बराबर या उनसे अधिक है।

segments.src: The largest items, Social Security and Medicare, remain bigger.
segments.tr: सबसे बड़ी मदें, सोशल सिक्योरिटी और मेडिकेयर, अभी भी बड़ी हैं।

segments.src: Still, interest differs from those programs in one important way: it is not a service Americans receive.
segments.tr: फिर भी, ब्याज उन कार्यक्रमों से एक महत्वपूर्ण तरीके से अलग है: यह ऐसी सेवा नहीं है जो अमेरिकियों को प्राप्त होती है।

segments.src: It is the cost of past borrowing, and it cannot be cut through ordinary program reforms.
segments.tr: यह पिछले उधार की लागत है, और इसे सामान्य कार्यक्रम सुधारों के माध्यम से कम नहीं किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: Exact rankings vary by year and by how spending is categorized, so it is worth checking the latest CBO and Treasury data when you read a headline comparison.
segments.tr: सटीक रैंकिंग वर्ष के अनुसार और खर्च को कैसे वर्गीकृत किया जाता है, इसके अनुसार बदलती रहती है, इसलिए जब आप हेडलाइन तुलना पढ़ें तो नवीनतम CBO और ट्रेजरी डेटा की जांच करना उचित है।

segments.src: ## Why it matters for budget fights
segments.tr: ## बजट की लड़ाइयों के लिए यह क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.
segments.tr: **पैंतरेबाज़ी के लिए कम जगह।** ब्याज पर खर्च किया गया प्रत्येक डॉलर सड़कों, अनुसंधान, रक्षा, स्वास्थ्य देखभाल या कर राहत के लिए उपलब्ध नहीं होता है, जब तक कि इसे और अधिक उधार लेकर वित्तपोषित न किया जाए।

segments.src: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.
segments.tr: वार्षिक खर्च बिलों पर बातचीत करने वाले कानून निर्माता कुल राशि के सापेक्ष विवेकाधीन धन के छोटे पूल के साथ काम करते हैं।

segments.src: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.
segments.tr: **एक फीडबैक लूप।** उच्च ब्याज लागत घाटे को बढ़ाती है, जिसके लिए अधिक उधार लेने की आवश्यकता होती है, जो भविष्य की ब्याज लागतों में जुड़ जाता है।

segments.src: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री कभी-कभी इसे चक्रवृद्धि प्रभाव (compounding effect) के रूप में वर्णित करते हैं।

segments.src: It is not inevitable, but it becomes harder to reverse as the debt grows relative to the economy.
segments.tr: यह अपरिहार्य नहीं है, लेकिन अर्थव्यवस्था के सापेक्ष ऋण बढ़ने पर इसे उलटना कठिन हो जाता है।

segments.src: **Political disagreement over the fix.** Analysts and policymakers differ on the response.
segments.tr: **समाधान पर राजनीतिक असहमति।** विश्लेषक और नीति निर्माता प्रतिक्रिया पर अलग-अलग राय रखते हैं।

segments.src: Some emphasize spending restraint, others favor raising revenue, and others stress faster economic growth.
segments.tr: कुछ खर्चों पर संयम बरतने पर जोर देते हैं, अन्य राजस्व बढ़ाने के पक्ष में हैं, और अन्य तेजी से आर्थिक विकास पर जोर देते हैं।

segments.src: Most nonpartisan analysts agree on one point: the arithmetic of rising interest costs makes the choices harder the longer they are postponed.
segments.tr: अधिकांश गैर-पक्षपाती विश्लेषक एक बिंदु पर सहमत हैं: बढ़ती ब्याज लागतों का गणित विकल्पों को और कठिन बना देता है, जितना अधिक उन्हें टाला जाता है।

segments.src: ## What it means for Treasury yields
segments.tr: ## ट्रेजरी यील्ड के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.
segments.tr: ट्रेजरी यील्ड वे कीमतें हैं जो बाजार सरकार को उधार देने के लिए निर्धारित करता है।

segments.src: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.
segments.tr: वे मुद्रास्फीति, फेड नीति, आर्थिक विकास और नए ऋण की आपूर्ति के बारे में अपेक्षाओं पर प्रतिक्रिया करते हैं।

segments.src: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.
segments.tr: जब सरकार को बड़ी मात्रा में प्रतिभूतियां बेचनी पड़ती हैं, तो निवेशक आपूर्ति को अवशोषित करने के लिए उच्च यील्ड की मांग कर सकते हैं, विशेष रूप से लंबी परिपक्वता अवधि के लिए।

segments.src: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.
segments.tr: राजकोषीय नीति, ऋण-सीमा गतिरोध और क्रेडिट-रेटिंग निर्णयों पर बहस भी बाजारों को प्रभावित कर सकती है।

segments.src: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.
segments.tr: उच्च यील्ड, बदले में, सरकार की भविष्य की उधार लेने की लागत को बढ़ाती है, और वे बंधक, कार ऋण और कॉर्पोरेट ऋण की दरों को प्रभावित करती हैं।

segments.src: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.
segments.tr: यील्ड कई कारकों से एक साथ प्रभावित होती है, इसलिए किसी एक कारक के प्रभाव को अलग करना कठिन है।

segments.src: Treat any single-cause explanation of a yield move with caution.
segments.tr: यील्ड चाल की किसी भी एकल-कारण व्याख्या को सावधानी से लें।

segments.src: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services
segments.tr: ## भविष्य के करों और सेवाओं के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ हो सकता है

segments.src: Interest costs do not directly set tax policy, but they shape the options.
segments.tr: ब्याज लागत सीधे कर नीति निर्धारित नहीं करती है, लेकिन वे विकल्पों को आकार देती हैं।

segments.src: In broad terms, a government facing growing interest obligations can:
segments.tr: व्यापक शब्दों में, बढ़ती ब्याज देनदारियों का सामना कर रही सरकार यह कर सकती है:

segments.src: 1. Raise revenue through taxes or fees.
segments.tr: 1. करों या शुल्क के माध्यम से राजस्व बढ़ाना।

segments.src: 2. Slow the growth of other spending.
segments.tr: 2. अन्य खर्चों की वृद्धि को धीमा करना।

segments.src: 3. Borrow more and accept higher interest costs.
segments.tr: 3. अधिक उधार लेना और उच्च ब्याज लागत स्वीकार करना।

segments.src: 4. Rely on stronger economic growth to expand the tax base.
segments.tr: 4. कर आधार का विस्तार करने के लिए मजबूत आर्थिक विकास पर भरोसा करना।

segments.src: In practice, governments usually use some mix.
segments.tr: व्यवहार में, सरकारें आमतौर पर कुछ मिश्रण का उपयोग करती हैं।

segments.src: Which mix to choose is a political decision, and reasonable people disagree.
segments.tr: कौन सा मिश्रण चुनना है, यह एक राजनीतिक निर्णय है, और उचित लोग असहमत हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: What the numbers do show is that deferring the decision does not remove the cost.
segments.tr: आंकड़े जो दिखाते हैं वह यह है कि निर्णय को टालने से लागत खत्म नहीं होती है।

segments.src: ## Key takeaways
segments.tr: ## मुख्य निष्कर्ष

segments.src: - Net interest has become one of the largest federal budget categories, at roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates.
segments.tr: - शुद्ध ब्याज सबसे बड़ी संघीय बजट श्रेणियों में से एक बन गया है, हालिया अनुमानों के अनुसार प्रति वर्ष लगभग $1 ट्रिलियन।

segments.src: - The increase comes from both a larger debt and higher interest rates, with refinancing spreading the effect over several years.
segments.tr: - यह वृद्धि बड़े ऋण और उच्च ब्याज दरों दोनों से आती है, जिसमें पुनर्वित्त प्रभाव को कई वर्षों में फैला देता है।

segments.src: - Interest spending is less flexible than most other parts of the budget.
segments.tr: - ब्याज खर्च बजट के अधिकांश अन्य हिस्सों की तुलना में कम लचीला है।

segments.src: - Treasury yields, deficits and fiscal debates influence one another.
segments.tr: - ट्रेजरी यील्ड, घाटा और राजकोषीय बहस एक-दूसरे को प्रभावित करते हैं।

segments.src: - Future tax and spending choices will be made against this backdrop.
segments.tr: - भविष्य के कर और खर्च के विकल्प इस पृष्ठभूमि के खिलाफ किए जाएंगे।

segments.src: ## Where to find reliable data
segments.tr: ## विश्वसनीय डेटा कहां खोजें

segments.src: For current figures, consult primary sources: the Congressional Budget Office's budget and economic outlook, the Treasury Department's Monthly Treasury Statement and Fiscal Data site, and the Office of Management and Budget.
segments.tr: वर्तमान आंकड़ों के लिए, प्राथमिक स्रोतों से परामर्श करें: कांग्रेसनल बजट ऑफिस का बजट और आर्थिक दृष्टिकोण, ट्रेजरी विभाग का मासिक ट्रेजरी विवरण और राजकोषीय डेटा साइट, और प्रबंधन और बजट कार्यालय।

segments.src: *This article is for general information and education only.
segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य जानकारी और शिक्षा के लिए है।

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice, and figures are approximate and may change as new data is released.*
segments.tr: यह निवेश, कर या वित्तीय सलाह नहीं है, और आंकड़े अनुमानित हैं और नया डेटा जारी होने पर बदल सकते हैं.*

es.title: La factura de intereses llega a su vencimiento: por qué los pagos de la deuda de Washington ahora compiten con sus mayores partidas presupuestarias

segments.src: For decades, interest on the national debt was a line item most Americans never thought about.
segments.tr: Durante décadas, el interés sobre la deuda nacional fue una partida que la mayoría de los estadounidenses nunca consideró.

segments.src: That is changing.
segments.tr: Eso está cambiando.

segments.src: Net interest, the amount the federal government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, has climbed to roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates from the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Treasury Department.
segments.tr: El interés neto, la cantidad que el gobierno federal paga por sus préstamos después de restar los intereses que gana, ha subido a aproximadamente 1 billón de dólares al año según estimaciones recientes de la Oficina de Presupuesto del Congreso (CBO) y del Departamento del Tesoro.

segments.src: That puts it in the same league as Medicare and national defense, and well above many programs that dominate budget debates.
segments.tr: Eso lo coloca al mismo nivel que Medicare y la defensa nacional, y muy por encima de muchos programas que dominan los debates presupuestarios.

segments.src: This explainer walks through why the bill has grown, how it works, and what it could mean for budget negotiations, Treasury yields and long-term fiscal choices.
segments.tr: Este artículo explicativo repasa por qué ha crecido la factura, cómo funciona y qué podría significar para las negociaciones presupuestarias, los rendimientos del Tesoro y las opciones fiscales a largo plazo.

segments.src: ## What "interest on the debt" actually means
segments.tr: ## Lo que significa realmente el "interés sobre la deuda"

segments.src: The federal government borrows by selling Treasury securities: short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: El gobierno federal se endeuda vendiendo valores del Tesoro: letras a corto plazo, notas a mediano plazo y bonos a largo plazo.

segments.src: Investors, including pension funds, banks, foreign governments, mutual funds and individuals, buy them and receive interest payments.
segments.tr: Los inversores, incluidos fondos de pensiones, bancos, gobiernos extranjeros, fondos mutuos y particulares, los compran y reciben pagos de intereses.

segments.src: Two figures are often mixed up:
segments.tr: A menudo se confunden dos cifras:

segments.src: - **Gross interest** is everything the government pays on all outstanding debt, including debt held by other parts of the government, such as trust funds.
segments.tr: - **El interés bruto** es todo lo que el gobierno paga sobre toda la deuda pendiente, incluida la deuda en poder de otras partes del gobierno, como los fondos fiduciarios.

segments.src: - **Net interest** subtracts interest the government receives, and it is the figure most budget analysts track because it reflects the real claim on the budget.
segments.tr: - **El interés neto** resta los intereses que recibe el gobierno, y es la cifra que la mayoría de los analistas presupuestarios siguen porque refleja la reclamación real sobre el presupuesto.

segments.src: Either way, the number has grown quickly in recent years, both in dollars and as a share of the economy and of federal spending.
segments.tr: De cualquier manera, el número ha crecido rápidamente en los últimos años, tanto en dólares como en proporción a la economía y al gasto federal.

segments.src: ## Two forces behind the rise
segments.tr: ## Dos fuerzas detrás del aumento

segments.src: ### 1. A bigger pile of debt
segments.tr: ### 1. Una mayor acumulación de deuda

segments.src: Federal debt held by the public has grown substantially over the past two decades.
segments.tr: La deuda federal en manos del público ha crecido sustancialmente en las últimas dos décadas.

segments.src: Recessions, the 2020 pandemic response, tax changes and the rising costs of an aging population have all contributed.
segments.tr: Las recesiones, la respuesta a la pandemia de 2020, los cambios impositivos y los crecientes costos de una población que envejece han contribuido a ello.

segments.src: Because the government has generally run annual deficits, new borrowing keeps adding to the base on which interest is charged.
segments.tr: Debido a que el gobierno generalmente ha registrado déficits anuales, los nuevos préstamos siguen aumentando la base sobre la cual se cobran intereses.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher interest rates
segments.tr: ### 2. Tasas de interés más altas

segments.src: For much of the 2010s, rates were historically low, so a large debt was relatively cheap to carry.
segments.tr: Durante gran parte de la década de 2010, las tasas fueron históricamente bajas, por lo que una gran deuda era relativamente barata de mantener.

segments.src: When inflation surged in 2022, the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate sharply, and yields across the Treasury market rose with it.
segments.tr: Cuando la inflación se disparó en 2022, la Reserva Federal aumentó drásticamente su tasa de referencia, y los rendimientos en todo el mercado del Tesoro aumentaron con ella.

segments.src: The effect does not show up all at once.
segments.tr: El efecto no se muestra todo de una vez.

segments.src: The Treasury continually refinances debt as older securities mature.
segments.tr: El Tesoro refinancia continuamente la deuda a medida que los valores más antiguos vencen.

segments.src: A bond issued at a low rate years ago is eventually replaced by one at today's higher rate, so the average rate on the whole debt drifts upward gradually.
segments.tr: Un bono emitido a una tasa baja hace años es eventualmente reemplazado por uno a la tasa más alta de hoy, por lo que la tasa promedio de toda la deuda se desplaza hacia arriba gradualmente.

segments.src: This is why interest costs can keep rising even after rates stop climbing.
segments.tr: Esta es la razón por la cual los costos de intereses pueden seguir subiendo incluso después de que las tasas dejen de subir.

segments.src: Short-term bills are especially sensitive.
segments.tr: Las letras a corto plazo son especialmente sensibles.

segments.src: They roll over frequently, so changes in the Fed's policy rate feed through to the government's costs within months.
segments.tr: Se renuevan con frecuencia, por lo que los cambios en la tasa de política de la Fed se transmiten a los costos del gobierno en cuestión de meses.

segments.src: ## How the numbers compare
segments.tr: ## Cómo se comparan las cifras

segments.src: Net interest now exceeds what the government spends on national defense in several recent fiscal-year estimates, and it rivals or surpasses Medicaid and many other major categories.
segments.tr: El interés neto ahora supera lo que el gobierno gasta en defensa nacional en varias estimaciones recientes de años fiscales, y rivaliza o supera a Medicaid y muchas otras categorías principales.

segments.src: The largest items, Social Security and Medicare, remain bigger.
segments.tr: Las partidas más grandes, el Seguro Social y Medicare, siguen siendo mayores.

segments.src: Still, interest differs from those programs in one important way: it is not a service Americans receive.
segments.tr: Aun así, los intereses difieren de esos programas en un aspecto importante: no son un servicio que los estadounidenses reciban.

segments.src: It is the cost of past borrowing, and it cannot be cut through ordinary program reforms.
segments.tr: Es el costo de préstamos pasados y no se puede recortar mediante reformas ordinarias de programas.

segments.src: Exact rankings vary by year and by how spending is categorized, so it is worth checking the latest CBO and Treasury data when you read a headline comparison.
segments.tr: Las clasificaciones exactas varían según el año y cómo se categoriza el gasto, por lo que vale la pena consultar los datos más recientes de la CBO y del Tesoro cuando lea una comparación de titulares.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for budget fights
segments.tr: ## Por qué es importante para las peleas presupuestarias

segments.src: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.
segments.tr: **Menos margen de maniobra.** Cada dólar gastado en intereses es un dólar que no está disponible para carreteras, investigación, defensa, atención médica o alivio fiscal, a menos que se financie con aún más préstamos.

segments.src: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.
segments.tr: Los legisladores que negocian proyectos de ley de gasto anual trabajan cada vez más con un fondo de fondos discrecionales más pequeño en relación con el total.

segments.src: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.
segments.tr: **Un bucle de retroalimentación.** Mayores costos de intereses amplían el déficit, lo que requiere más préstamos, lo que aumenta los futuros costos de intereses.

segments.src: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: Los economistas a veces describen esto como un efecto compuesto.

segments.src: It is not inevitable, but it becomes harder to reverse as the debt grows relative to the economy.
segments.tr: No es inevitable, pero se vuelve más difícil de revertir a medida que la deuda crece en relación con la economía.

segments.src: **Political disagreement over the fix.** Analysts and policymakers differ on the response.
segments.tr: **Desacuerdo político sobre la solución.** Los analistas y responsables políticos difieren en la respuesta.

segments.src: Some emphasize spending restraint, others favor raising revenue, and others stress faster economic growth.
segments.tr: Algunos enfatizan la moderación del gasto, otros favorecen el aumento de los ingresos y otros enfatizan un crecimiento económico más rápido.

segments.src: Most nonpartisan analysts agree on one point: the arithmetic of rising interest costs makes the choices harder the longer they are postponed.
segments.tr: La mayoría de los analistas no partidistas coinciden en un punto: la aritmética de los crecientes costos de intereses hace que las opciones sean más difíciles cuanto más se posponen.

segments.src: ## What it means for Treasury yields
segments.tr: ## Lo que significa para los rendimientos del Tesoro

segments.src: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.
segments.tr: Los rendimientos del Tesoro son los precios que el mercado establece para prestar al gobierno.

segments.src: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.
segments.tr: Responden a las expectativas sobre la inflación, la política de la Fed, el crecimiento económico y la oferta de nueva deuda.

segments.src: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.
segments.tr: Cuando el gobierno debe vender grandes cantidades de valores, los inversores pueden exigir mayores rendimientos para absorber la oferta, especialmente para vencimientos más largos.

segments.src: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.
segments.tr: Los debates sobre la política fiscal, los enfrentamientos sobre el límite de la deuda y las decisiones de calificación crediticia también pueden mover los mercados.

segments.src: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.
segments.tr: Mayores rendimientos, a su vez, elevan los futuros costos de endeudamiento del gobierno e influyen en las tasas de hipotecas, préstamos para automóviles y deuda corporativa.

segments.src: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.
segments.tr: Los rendimientos están influenciados por muchos factores a la vez, por lo que es difícil aislar el efecto de uno solo.

segments.src: Treat any single-cause explanation of a yield move with caution.
segments.tr: Trate cualquier explicación de causa única de un movimiento de rendimiento con precaución.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services
segments.tr: ## Lo que podría significar para futuros impuestos y servicios

segments.src: Interest costs do not directly set tax policy, but they shape the options.
segments.tr: Los costos de intereses no establecen directamente la política fiscal, pero configuran las opciones.

segments.src: In broad terms, a government facing growing interest obligations can:
segments.tr: En términos generales, un gobierno que enfrenta crecientes obligaciones de intereses puede:

segments.src: 1. Raise revenue through taxes or fees.
segments.tr: 1. Aumentar los ingresos a través de impuestos o tarifas.

segments.src: 2. Slow the growth of other spending.
segments.tr: 2. Frenar el crecimiento de otros gastos.

segments.src: 3. Borrow more and accept higher interest costs.
segments.tr: 3. Tomar más prestado y aceptar mayores costos de intereses.

segments.src: 4. Rely on stronger economic growth to expand the tax base.
segments.tr: 4. Depender de un crecimiento económico más fuerte para ampliar la base impositiva.

segments.src: In practice, governments usually use some mix.
segments.tr: En la práctica, los gobiernos suelen utilizar una combinación.

segments.src: Which mix to choose is a political decision, and reasonable people disagree.
segments.tr: Qué combinación elegir es una decisión política, y las personas razonables no están de acuerdo.

segments.src: What the numbers do show is that deferring the decision does not remove the cost.
segments.tr: Lo que muestran las cifras es que posponer la decisión no elimina el costo.

segments.src: ## Key takeaways
segments.tr: ## Puntos clave

segments.src: - Net interest has become one of the largest federal budget categories, at roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates.
segments.tr: - El interés neto se ha convertido en una de las mayores categorías del presupuesto federal, con aproximadamente 1 billón de dólares al año según estimaciones recientes.

segments.src: - The increase comes from both a larger debt and higher interest rates, with refinancing spreading the effect over several years.
segments.tr: - El aumento proviene tanto de una mayor deuda como de mayores tasas de interés, y la refinanciación distribuye el efecto a lo largo de varios años.

segments.src: - Interest spending is less flexible than most other parts of the budget.
segments.tr: - El gasto en intereses es menos flexible que la mayoría de las otras partes del presupuesto.

segments.src: - Treasury yields, deficits and fiscal debates influence one another.
segments.tr: - Los rendimientos del Tesoro, los déficits y los debates fiscales se influencian mutuamente.

segments.src: - Future tax and spending choices will be made against this backdrop.
segments.tr: - Las futuras opciones de impuestos y gastos se tomarán en este contexto.

segments.src: ## Where to find reliable data
segments.tr: ## Dónde encontrar datos confiables

segments.src: For current figures, consult primary sources: the Congressional Budget Office's budget and economic outlook, the Treasury Department's Monthly Treasury Statement and Fiscal Data site, and the Office of Management and Budget.
segments.tr: Para cifras actuales, consulte fuentes primarias: el presupuesto y perspectiva económica de la Oficina de Presupuesto del Congreso, el sitio de la Declaración Mensual del Tesoro y Datos Fiscales del Departamento del Tesoro, y la Oficina de Administración y Presupuesto.

segments.tr: *Este artículo es solo para información general y educativa.

segments.tr: No es asesoramiento de inversión, fiscal o financiero, y las cifras son aproximadas y pueden cambiar a medida que se publiquen nuevos datos.*

ar.title: استحقاق فاتورة الفوائد: لماذا تنافس مدفوعات ديون واشنطن الآن أكبر بنود ميزانيتها

segments.src: For decades, interest on the national debt was a line item most Americans never thought about.
segments.tr: عقوداً من الزمن، كانت فوائد الدين الوطني بنداً لا يككر فيه معظم الأمريكيين تفكيراً.

segments.src: That is changing.
segments.tr: هذا يتغير.

segments.src: Net interest, the amount the federal government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, has climbed to roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates from the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Treasury Department.
segments.tr: صافي الفائدة، وهو المبلغ الذي تدفعه الحكومة الفيدرالية على اقتراضها بعد طرح الفوائد التي تكسبها، ارتفع إلى نحو تريليون دولار سنوياً وفقاً للتقديرات الحديثة الصادرة عن مكتب CBO ووزارة الخزانة.

segments.src: That puts it in the same league as Medicare and national defense, and well above many programs that dominate budget debates.
segments.tr: هذا يضعه في نفس مرتبة الرعاية الصحية Medicare والدفاع الوطني، وأعلى بكثير من العديد من البرامج التي تهيمن على نقاشات الميزانية.

segments.src: This explainer walks through why the bill has grown, how it works, and what it could mean for budget negotiations, Treasury yields and long-term fiscal choices.
segments.tr: يشرح هذا الدليل سبب نمو الفاتورة، وكيف تعمل، وما يمكن أن تعنيه لمفاوضات الميزانية وعوائد الخزانة والخيارات المالية طويلة الأجل.

segments.src: ## What "interest on the debt" actually means
segments.tr: ## ما تعنيه "فوائد الدين" في الواقع

segments.src: The federal government borrows by selling Treasury securities: short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: تقترض الحكومة الفيدرالية عن طريق بيع أوراق مالية للخزانة: سندات قصيرة الأجل، وملاحظات متوسطة الأجل، وسندات طويلة الأجل.

segments.src: Investors, including pension funds, banks, foreign governments, mutual funds and individuals, buy them and receive interest payments.
segments.tr: المستثمرون، بما في ذلك صناديق التقاعد، والبنوك، والحكومات الأجنبية، وصناديق الاستثمار المشترك والأفراد، يمشترونها ويتلقون مدفوعات فوائد.

segments.src: Two figures are often mixed up:
segments.tr: غالباً ما يتم الخلط بين رقمين:

segments.src: - **Gross interest** is everything the government pays on all outstanding debt, including debt held by other parts of the government, such as trust funds.
segments.tr: - **إجمالي الفائدة** هو كل ما تدفعه الحكومة على جميع الديون القائمة، بما في ذلك الديون المحتفظ بها من قبل أجزاء أخرى من الحكومة، مثل صناديق الاستئمان.

segments.src: - **Net interest** subtracts interest the government receives, and it is the figure most budget analysts track because it reflects the real claim on the budget.
segments.tr: - **صافي الفائدة** يطرح الفوائد التي تتلقاها الحكومة، وهو الرقم الذي يتابعه معظم محللي الميزانية لأنه يعكس المطالبة الحقيقية على الميزانية.

segments.src: Either way, the number has grown quickly in recent years, both in dollars and as a share of the economy and of federal spending.
segments.tr: في كلتا الحالتين، نمت الأرقام بسرعة في السنوات الأخيرة، سواء من حيث الدولارات أو كنسبة من الاقتصاد ومن الإنفاق الفيدرالي.

segments.src: ## Two forces behind the rise
segments.tr: ## قوتان خلف الارتفاع

segments.src: ### 1. A bigger pile of debt
segments.tr: ### 1. كومة أكبر من الديون

segments.src: Federal debt held by the public has grown substantially over the past two decades.
segments.tr: نما الدين الفيدرالي المحتفظ به من قبل الجمهور بشكل كبير على مدار العقدين الماضيين.

segments.src: Recessions, the 2020 pandemic response, tax changes and the rising costs of an aging population have all contributed.
segments.tr: ساهمت الركودات، استجابة جائحة 2020، والتغيرات الضريبية، والتكاليف المتزايدة لشيخوخة السكان في ذلك كله.

segments.src: Because the government has generally run annual deficits, new borrowing keeps adding to the base on which interest is charged.
segments.tr: لأن الحكومة عموماً سجلت عجوزات سنوية، فإن الاقتراض الجديد يستمر في إضافة الأساس الذي تُفرض عليه الفوائد.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher interest rates
segments.tr: ### 2. أسعار فائدة أعلى

segments.src: For much of the 2010s, rates were historically low, so a large debt was relatively cheap to carry.
segments.tr: لجزء كبير من عقد 2010، كانت الأسعار منخفضة تاريخياً، لذا كان حمل ديون كبيرة رخيصاً نسبياً.

segments.src: When inflation surged in 2022, the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate sharply, and yields across the Treasury market rose with it.
segments.tr: عندما ارتفع التضخم بشدة في 2022، رفع الاحتياطي الفيدرالي سعره المعياري بحدة، وارتفعت العوائد في سوق الخزانة معه.

segments.src: The effect does not show up all at once.
segments.tr: لا يظهر التأثير دفعة واحدة.

segments.src: The Treasury continually refinances debt as older securities mature.
segments.tr: تعيد الخزانة تمويل الدين باستمرار مع نضج الأوراق المالية القديمة.

segments.src: A bond issued at a low rate years ago is eventually replaced by one at today's higher rate, so the average rate on the whole debt drifts upward gradually.
segments.tr: يتم استبدال السند الصادر بسعر منخفض قبل سنوات بأخر بسعر اليوم الأعلى، لذا فإن المتوسط على إجمالي الدين ينجرف تدريجياً نحو الأعلى.

segments.src: This is why interest costs can keep rising even after rates stop climbing.
segments.tr: هذا هو سبب استمرار تكاليف الفائدة في الارتفاع حتى بعد توقف الأسعار عن الصعود.

segments.src: Short-term bills are especially sensitive.
segments.tr: الفواتير قصيرة الأجل حساسة بشكل خاص.

segments.src: They roll over frequently, so changes in the Fed's policy rate feed through to the government's costs within months.
segments.tr: فهي تُجدد بشكل متكرر، لذا فإن التغييرات في سعر سياسة الاحتياطي الفيدرالي تنتقل إلى تكاليف الحكومة في غضون أشهر.

segments.src: ## How the numbers compare
segments.tr: ## كيف تقارن الأرقام

segments.src: Net interest now exceeds what the government spends on national defense in several recent fiscal-year estimates, and it rivals or surpasses Medicaid and many other major categories.
segments.tr: يتجاوز صافي الفائدة الآن ما تنفقه الحكومة على الدفاع الوطني في عدة تقديرات للسنة المالية الأخيرة، وينافس أو يتجاوز Medicaid والعديد من الفئات الرئيسية الأخرى.

segments.src: The largest items, Social Security and Medicare, remain bigger.
segments.tr: تبقى البنود الأكبر، Social Security و Medicare، أكبر.

segments.src: Still, interest differs from those programs in one important way: it is not a service Americans receive.
segments.tr: مع ذلك، تختلف الفائدة عن هذه البرامج في أمر مهم واحد: إنها ليست خدمة يتلقاها الأمريكيون.

segments.src: It is the cost of past borrowing, and it cannot be cut through ordinary program reforms.
segments.tr: إنها تكلفة الاقتراض الماضي، ولا يمكن خفضها من خلال إصلاحات البرامج العادية.

segments.src: Exact rankings vary by year and by how spending is categorized, so it is worth checking the latest CBO and Treasury data when you read a headline comparison.
segments.tr: تختلف الترتيبات الدقيقة حسب السنة وكيفية تصنيف الإنفاق، لذا يجدر التحقق من أحدث بيانات CBO والخزانة عندما تقرأ مقارنة في عنوان رئيسي.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for budget fights
segments.tr: ## لماذا يهم لمعارك الميزانية

segments.src: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.
segments.tr: **مساحة أقل للمناورة.** كل دولار يتم إنفاقه على الفائدة هو دولار غير متاح للطرق أو الأبحاث أو الدفاع أو الرعاية الصحية أو الإعفاء الضريبي، ما لم يتم تمويله باقتراض أكبر.

segments.src: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.
segments.tr: يعمل المشرعون الذين يتفاوضون على فواتير الإنفاق السنوي بشكل متزايد مع مجموعة أصغر من الأموال التقديرية مقارنة بالمجموع.

segments.src: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.
segments.tr: **حلقة تغذية مرتدة.** تكاليف الفائدة الأعلى توسع العجز، مما يتطلب اقتراضاً أكبر، مما يضيف إلى تكاليف الفائدة المستقبلية.

segments.src: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: يوصف هذا أحياناً من قبل الاقتصاديين بأنه تأثير مركب.

segments.src: It is not inevitable, but it becomes harder to reverse as the debt grows relative to the economy.
segments.tr: إنه ليس أمراً حتمياً، ولكنه يصبح أ صعباً في العكس كلما نمى الدين بالنسبة للاقتصاد.

segments.src: **Political disagreement over the fix.** Analysts and policymakers differ on the response.
segments.tr: **خلاف سياسي حول الإصلاح.** يختلف المحللون وصناع السياسات في الاستجابة.

segments.src: Some emphasize spending restraint, others favor raising revenue, and others stress faster economic growth.
segments.tr: بعضهم يؤكد على ضبط الإنفاق، وآخرون يفضلون زيادة الإيرادات، وآخرون يشددون على نمو اقتصادي أسرع.

segments.src: Most nonpartisan analysts agree on one point: the arithmetic of rising interest costs makes the choices harder the longer they are postponed.
segments.tr: يتفق معظم المحللين غير الحزبيين على نقطة واحدة: حسابات تكاليف الفائدة المتزايدة تجعل الخيارات أصعب كلما تم تأجيلها.

segments.src: ## What it means for Treasury yields
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني لعوائد الخزانة

segments.src: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.
segments.tr: عوائد الخزانة هي الأسعار التي يحددها السوق للإقراض للحكومة.

segments.src: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.
segments.tr: وهي تستجيب للتوقعات حول التضخم، وسياسة الاحتياطي الفيدرالي، والنمو الاقتصادي، وعرض الديون الجديدة.

segments.src: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.
segments.tr: عندما يتعين على الحكومة بيع كميات كبيرة من الأوراق المالية، قد يطلب المستثمرون عوائد أعلى لاستيعاب العرض، خاصة للآجال الأطول.

segments.src: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تحرك النقاشات حول السياسة المالية، ومواجهات سقف الدين، وقرارات التصنيف الائتماني الأسواق أيضاً.

segments.src: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.
segments.tr: العوائد الأعلى، بدورها، ترفع تكاليف الاقتراض المستقبلية للحكومة، وهي تؤثر على أسعار الرهون العقارية، وقروض السيارات، وديون الشركات.

segments.src: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.
segments.tr: تتأثر العوائد بالعديد من العوامل دفعة واحدة، لذا يصعب عزل تأثير أي عامل بمفرده.

segments.src: Treat any single-cause explanation of a yield move with caution.
segments.tr: تعامل مع أي تفسير ذو سبب واحد لحركة العائد بحذر.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services
segments.tr: ## ما يمكن أن يعنيه للضرائب والخدمات المستقبلية

segments.src: Interest costs do not directly set tax policy, but they shape the options.
segments.tr: لا تحدد تكاليف الفائدة السياسة الضريبية بشكل مباشر، لكنها تشكل الخيارات.

segments.src: In broad terms, a government facing growing interest obligations can:
segments.tr: بشكل عام، يمكن للحكومة التي تواجه التزامات فائدة متزايدة أن:

segments.src: 1. Raise revenue through taxes or fees.
segments.tr: 1. تزيد الإيرادات من خلال الضرائب أو الرسوم.

segments.src: 2. Slow the growth of other spending.
segments.tr: 2. تبطئ نمو الإنفاق الأخرى.

segments.src: 3. Borrow more and accept higher interest costs.
segments.tr: 3. تقترض أكثر وتقبل تكاليف فائدة أعلى.

segments.src: 4. Rely on stronger economic growth to expand the tax base.
segments.tr: 4. تعتمد على نمو اقتصادي أقوى لتوسيع القاعدة الضريبية.

segments.src: In practice, governments usually use some mix.
segments.tr: في الممارسة العملية، تستخدم الحكومات عادة مزيجاً ما.

segments.src: Which mix to choose is a political decision, and reasonable people disagree.
segments.tr: أي مزيج يتم اختيار هو قرار سياسي، والناس العقلانيون مختلفون.

segments.src: What the numbers do show is that deferring the decision does not remove the cost.
segments.tr: ما توضحه الأرقام هو أن تأجيل القرار لا يزيل التكلفة.

segments.src: ## Key takeaways
segments.tr: ## الوجبات الرئيسية

segments.src: - Net interest has become one of the largest federal budget categories, at roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates.
segments.tr: - أصبح صافي الفائدة واحدة من أكبر فئات الميزانية الفيدرالية، بنحو تريليون دولار سنوياً وفقاً للتقديرات الحديثة.

segments.src: - The increase comes from both a larger debt and higher interest rates, with refinancing spreading the effect over several years.
segments.tr: - تأتي الزيادة من دين أكبر وأسعار فائدة أعلى، مع إعادة التمويل التي تنشر التأثير على مدى عدة سنوات.

segments.src: - Interest spending is less flexible than most other parts of the budget.
segments.tr: - إنفاق الفائدة أقل مرونة من معظم أجزاء الميزانية الأخرى.

segments.src: - Treasury yields, deficits and fiscal debates influence one another.
segments.tr: - تؤثر عوائد الخزانة، والعجوزات، والنقاشات المالية على بعضها البعض.

segments.src: - Future tax and spending choices will be made against this backdrop.
segments.tr: - ستُتخذ خيارات الضرائب والإنفاق المستقبلية في مواجهة هذه الخلفية.

segments.src: ## Where to find reliable data
segments.tr: ## أين تجد بيانات موثوقة

segments.src: For current figures, consult primary sources: the Congressional Budget Office's budget and economic outlook, the Treasury Department's Monthly Treasury Statement and Fiscal Data site, and the Office of Management and Budget.
segments.tr: للأرقام الحالية، راجع المصادر الأساسية: ميزانية مكتب CBO والتوقعات الاقتصادية، وبيان الخزانة الشهري لوزارة الخزانة وموقع البيانات المالية، ومكتب الإدارة والميزانية.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and education only.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة للمعلومات العامة والتعليم فقط.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice, and figures are approximate and may change as new data is released.*
segments.tr: وليست استشارة استثمارية أو ضريبية أو مالية، والأرقام تقريبية وقد تتغير مع إصدار بيانات جديدة.*

fr.title: La facture des intérêts arrive à échéance : pourquoi le service de la dette de Washington rivalise désormais avec ses plus grands postes budgétaires

segments.src: For decades, interest on the national debt was a line item most Americans never thought about.
segments.tr: Pendant des décennies, les intérêts sur la dette nationale ont été un poste budgétaire auquel la plupart des Américains ne pensaient jamais.

segments.src: That is changing.
segments.tr: Cela est en train de changer.

segments.src: Net interest, the amount the federal government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, has climbed to roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates from the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Treasury Department.
segments.tr: Les intérêts nets, c'est-à-dire le montant que le gouvernement fédéral paie sur ses emprunts après déduction des intérêts qu'il perçoit, ont atteint environ 1 000 milliards de dollars par an selon les estimations récentes du Congressional Budget Office (CBO) et du département du Trésor.

segments.src: That puts it in the same league as Medicare and national defense, and well above many programs that dominate budget debates.
segments.tr: Cela les place dans la même catégorie que Medicare et la défense nationale, et bien au-dessus de nombreux programmes qui dominent les débats budgétaires.

segments.src: This explainer walks through why the bill has grown, how it works, and what it could mean for budget negotiations, Treasury yields and long-term fiscal choices.
segments.tr: Cet article explicatif passe en revue les raisons pour lesquelles la facture a augmenté, son fonctionnement et ce que cela pourrait signifier pour les négociations budgétaires, les rendements des bons du Trésor et les choix budgétaires à long terme.

segments.src: ## What "interest on the debt" actually means
segments.tr: ## Ce que signifie réellement « les intérêts sur la dette »

segments.src: The federal government borrows by selling Treasury securities: short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: Le gouvernement fédéral emprunte en vendants des titres du Trésor : des bons à court terme, des notes à moyen terme et des obligations à long terme.

segments.src: Investors, including pension funds, banks, foreign governments, mutual funds and individuals, buy them and receive interest payments.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs, y compris les fonds de pension, les banques, les gouvernements étrangers, les fonds communs de placement et les particuliers, les achètent et reçoivent des paiements d'intérêts.

segments.src: Two figures are often mixed up:
segments.tr: Deux chiffres sont souvent confondus :

segments.src: - **Gross interest** is everything the government pays on all outstanding debt, including debt held by other parts of the government, such as trust funds.
segments.tr: - **Intérêts bruts** : tout ce que le gouvernement paie sur l'ensemble de la dette en cours, y compris la dette détenue par d'autres parties du gouvernement, telles que les fonds fiduciaires.

segments.src: - **Net interest** subtracts interest the government receives, and it is the figure most budget analysts track because it reflects the real claim on the budget.
segments.tr: - **Intérêts nets** : déduisent les intérêts reçus par le gouvernement, et c'est le chiffre que la plupart des analystes budgétaires suivent car il reflète la charge réelle sur le budget.

segments.src: Either way, the number has grown quickly in recent years, both in dollars and as a share of the economy and of federal spending.
segments.tr: Quoi qu'il en soit, le chiffre a rapidement augmenté ces dernières années, à la fois en dollars et en tant que part de l'économie et des dépenses fédérales.

segments.src: ## Two forces behind the rise
segments.tr: ## Deux forces à l'origine de la hausse

segments.src: ### 1. A bigger pile of debt
segments.tr: ### 1. Une plus grande accumulation de dette

segments.src: Federal debt held by the public has grown substantially over the past two decades.
segments.tr: La dette fédérale détenue par le public a considérablement augmenté au cours des deux dernières décennies.

segments.src: Recessions, the 2020 pandemic response, tax changes and the rising costs of an aging population have all contributed.
segments.tr: Les récessions, la réponse à la pandémie de 2020, les modifications fiscales et la hausse des coûts d'une population vieillissante y ont toutes contribué.

segments.src: Because the government has generally run annual deficits, new borrowing keeps adding to the base on which interest is charged.
segments.tr: Étant donné que le gouvernement a généralement enregistré des déficits annuels, les nouveaux emprunts continuent d'augmenter la base sur laquelle les intérêts sont calculés.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher interest rates
segments.tr: ### 2. Des taux d'intérêt plus élevés

segments.src: For much of the 2010s, rates were historically low, so a large debt was relatively cheap to carry.
segments.tr: Pendant une grande partie des années 2010, les taux étaient historiquement bas, de sorte qu'une dette importante était relativement bon marché à porter.

segments.src: When inflation surged in 2022, the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate sharply, and yields across the Treasury market rose with it.
segments.tr: Lorsque l'inflation a bondi en 2022, la Réserve fédérale a fortement relevé son taux directeur et les rendements sur le marché du Trésor ont augmenté en conséquence.

segments.src: The effect does not show up all at once.
segments.tr: L'effet ne se fait pas sentir tout d'un coup.

segments.src: The Treasury continually refinances debt as older securities mature.
segments.tr: Le Trésor refinance continuellement sa dette à mesure que les anciens titres arrivent à échéance.

segments.src: A bond issued at a low rate years ago is eventually replaced by one at today's higher rate, so the average rate on the whole debt drifts upward gradually.
segments.tr: Une obligation émise à un taux bas il y a plusieurs années est finalement remplacée par une obligation au taux plus élevé d'aujourd'hui, de sorte que le taux moyen sur l'ensemble de la dette augmente progressivement.

segments.src: This is why interest costs can keep rising even after rates stop climbing.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi les coûts d'intérêt peuvent continuer à augmenter même après que les taux ont cessé de grimper.

segments.src: Short-term bills are especially sensitive.
segments.tr: Les bons à court terme sont particulièrement sensibles.

segments.src: They roll over frequently, so changes in the Fed's policy rate feed through to the government's costs within months.
segments.tr: Ils sont renouvelés fréquemment, de sorte que les changements dans le taux directeur de la Fed se répercutent sur les coûts du gouvernement en quelques mois.

segments.src: ## How the numbers compare
segments.tr: ## Comment les chiffres se comparent

segments.src: Net interest now exceeds what the government spends on national defense in several recent fiscal-year estimates, and it rivals or surpasses Medicaid and many other major categories.
segments.tr: Les intérêts nets dépassent désormais ce que le gouvernement dépense pour la défense nationale dans plusieurs estimations récentes d'exercices fiscaux, et ils rivalisent ou surpassent Medicaid et de nombreuses autres catégories majeures.

segments.src: The largest items, Social Security and Medicare, remain bigger.
segments.tr: Les plus grands postes, Social Security et Medicare, restent plus importants.

segments.src: Still, interest differs from those programs in one important way: it is not a service Americans receive.
segments.tr: Cependant, les intérêts diffèrent de ces programmes d'une manière importante : ce n'est pas un service que les Américains reçoivent.

segments.src: It is the cost of past borrowing, and it cannot be cut through ordinary program reforms.
segments.tr: C'est le coût d'emprunts passés, et il ne peut pas être réduit par des réformes de programmes ordinaires.

segments.src: Exact rankings vary by year and by how spending is categorized, so it is worth checking the latest CBO and Treasury data when you read a headline comparison.
segments.tr: Les classements exacts varient selon l'année et la manière dont les dépenses sont catégorisées, il est donc utile de consulter les dernières données du CBO et du Trésor lorsque vous lisez une comparaison de titres.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for budget fights
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cela compte pour les luttes budgétaires

segments.src: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.
segments.tr: **Moins de marge de manœuvre.** Chaque dollar dépensé en intérêts est un dollar non disponible pour les routes, la recherche, la défense, les soins de santé ou les allégements fiscaux, à moins d'être financé par des emprunts encore plus importants.

segments.src: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.
segments.tr: Les législateurs qui négocient les projets de loi de dépenses annuels travaillent de plus en plus avec un pool plus restreint de fonds discrétionnaires par rapport au total.

segments.src: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.
segments.tr: **Une boucle de rétroaction.** Des coûts d'intérêt plus élevés élargissent le déficit, ce qui nécessite plus d'emprunts, ce qui augmente les futurs coûts d'intérêt.

segments.src: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: Les économistes décrivent parfois cela comme un effet cumulatif.

segments.src: It is not inevitable, but it becomes harder to reverse as the debt grows relative to the economy.
segments.tr: Ce n'est pas inévitable, mais cela devient plus difficile à inverser à mesure que la dette augmente par rapport à l'économie.

segments.src: **Political disagreement over the fix.** Analysts and policymakers differ on the response.
segments.tr: **Désaccord politique sur la solution.** Les analystes et les décideurs politiques divergent sur la réponse.

segments.src: Some emphasize spending restraint, others favor raising revenue, and others stress faster economic growth.
segments.tr: Certains mettent l'accent sur la modération des dépenses, d'autres favorisent l'augmentation des recettes, et d'autres encore insistent sur une croissance économique plus rapide.

segments.src: Most nonpartisan analysts agree on one point: the arithmetic of rising interest costs makes the choices harder the longer they are postponed.
segments.tr: La plupart des analystes non partisans s'accordent sur un point : l'arithmétique de la hausse des coûts d'intérêt rend les choix plus difficiles plus ils sont reportés.

segments.src: ## What it means for Treasury yields
segments.tr: **Ce que cela signifie pour les rendements du Trésor

segments.src: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.
segments.tr: Les rendements du Trésor sont les prix fixés par le marché pour prêter au gouvernement.

segments.src: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.
segments.tr: Ils réagissent aux attentes concernant l'inflation, la politique de la Fed, la croissance économique et l'offre de nouvelle dette.

segments.src: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.
segments.tr: Lorsque le gouvernement doit vendre de grandes quantités de titres, les investisseurs peuvent exiger des rendements plus élevés pour absorber l'offre, en particulier pour les échéances plus longues.

segments.src: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.
segments.tr: Les débats sur la politique budgétaire, les impasses sur le plafond de la dette et les décisions des agences de notation peuvent également faire bouger les marchés.

segments.src: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.
segments.tr: Des rendements plus élevés augmentent à leur tour les futurs coûts d'emprunt du gouvernement et influencent les taux des hypothèques, des prêts automobiles et de la dette des entreprises.

segments.src: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.
segments.tr: Les rendements sont influencés par de nombreux facteurs à la fois, il est donc difficile d'isoler l'effet d'un seul facteur.

segments.src: Treat any single-cause explanation of a yield move with caution.
segments.tr: Traitez toute explication à cause unique d'un mouvement de rendement avec prudence.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela pourrait signifier pour les taxes et les services futurs

segments.src: Interest costs do not directly set tax policy, but they shape the options.
segments.tr: Les coûts d'intérêt ne fixent pas directement la politique fiscale, mais ils façonnent les options.

segments.src: In broad terms, a government facing growing interest obligations can:
segments.tr: En termes généraux, un gouvernement confronté à des obligations d'intérêts croissantes peut :

segments.src: 1. Raise revenue through taxes or fees.
segments.tr: 1. Augmenter les recettes par le biais d'impôts ou de taxes.

segments.src: 2. Slow the growth of other spending.
segments.tr: 2. Ralentir la croissance des autres dépenses.

segments.src: 3. Borrow more and accept higher interest costs.
segments.tr: 3. Emprunter davantage et accepter des coûts d'intérêt plus élevés.

segments.src: 4. Rely on stronger economic growth to expand the tax base.
segments.tr: 4. Compter sur une croissance économique plus forte pour élargir l'assiette fiscale.

segments.src: In practice, governments usually use some mix.
segments.tr: Dans la pratique, les gouvernements utilisent généralement un certain mélange.

segments.src: Which mix to choose is a political decision, and reasonable people disagree.
segments.tr: Quel mélange choisir est une décision politique, et des personnes raisonnables ne sont pas d'accord.

segments.src: What the numbers do show is that deferring the decision does not remove the cost.
segments.tr: Ce que les chiffres montrent, c'est que différer la décision ne supprime pas le coût.

segments.src: ## Key takeaways
segments.tr: ## Points clés à retenir

segments.src: - Net interest has become one of the largest federal budget categories, at roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates.
segments.tr: - Les intérêts nets sont devenus l'une des plus grandes catégories du budget fédéral, à environ 1 000 milliards de dollars par an selon les estimations récentes.

segments.src: - The increase comes from both a larger debt and higher interest rates, with refinancing spreading the effect over several years.

segments.src: - Interest spending is less flexible than most other parts of the budget.
segments.tr: - Les dépenses d'intérêt sont moins flexibles que la plupart des autres parties du budget.

segments.src: - Treasury yields, deficits and fiscal debates influence one another.
segments.tr: - Les rendements du Trésor, les déficits et les débats budgétaires s'influencent mutuellement.

segments.src: - Future tax and spending choices will be made against this backdrop.
segments.tr: - Les futurs choix en matière de fiscalité et de dépenses seront faits dans ce contexte.
