segments.tr: Inilah sebabnya mengapa biaya bunga dapat terus meningkat bahkan setelah suku bunga berhenti naik.

segments.src: Short-term bills are especially sensitive.
segments.tr: Wesel jangka pendek sangat sensitif.

segments.src: They roll over frequently, so changes in the Fed's policy rate feed through to the government's costs within months.
segments.tr: Wesel tersebut sering diperbarui, sehingga perubahan suku bunga kebijakan Fed berdampak pada biaya pemerintah dalam beberapa bulan.

segments.src: ## How the numbers compare
segments.tr: ## Perbandingan angka

segments.src: Net interest now exceeds what the government spends on national defense in several recent fiscal-year estimates, and it rivals or surpasses Medicaid and many other major categories.
segments.tr: Bunga bersih sekarang melebihi apa yang dibelanjakan pemerintah untuk pertahanan nasional dalam beberapa perkiraan tahun fiskal terakhir, dan menyaingi atau melampaui Medicaid dan banyak kategori utama lainnya.

segments.src: The largest items, Social Security and Medicare, remain bigger.
segments.tr: Pos terbesar, Jaminan Sosial dan Medicare, tetap lebih besar.

segments.src: Still, interest differs from those programs in one important way: it is not a service Americans receive.
segments.tr: Namun, bunga berbeda dari program-program tersebut dalam satu hal penting: bunga bukanlah layanan yang diterima orang Amerika.

segments.src: It is the cost of past borrowing, and it cannot be cut through ordinary program reforms.
segments.tr: Itu adalah biaya pinjaman masa lalu, dan tidak dapat dipotong melalui reformasi program biasa.

segments.src: Exact rankings vary by year and by how spending is categorized, so it is worth checking the latest CBO and Treasury data when you read a headline comparison.
segments.tr: Peringkat yang tepat bervariasi menurut tahun dan cara pengeluaran dikategorikan, jadi ada baiknya memeriksa data terbaru CBO dan Departemen Keuangan saat Anda membaca perbandingan utama.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for budget fights
segments.tr: ## Mengapa hal itu penting untuk pertikaian anggaran

segments.src: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.
segments.tr: **Lebih sedikit ruang untuk bergerak.** Setiap dolar yang dihabiskan untuk bunga adalah dolar yang tidak tersedia untuk jalan raya, penelitian, pertahanan, perawatan kesehatan, atau keringanan pajak, kecuali dibiayai oleh pinjaman yang lebih besar lagi.

segments.src: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.
segments.tr: Para pembuat undang-undang yang merundingkan RUU pengeluaran tahunan semakin bekerja dengan kumpulan dana diskresioner yang lebih kecil relatif terhadap totalnya.

segments.src: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.
segments.tr: **Lingkaran umpan balik.** Biaya bunga yang lebih tinggi memperlebar defisit, yang membutuhkan lebih banyak pinjaman, yang menambah biaya bunga di masa mendatang.

segments.src: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: Para ekonom terkadang menggambarkan ini sebagai efek majemuk.

segments.src: It is not inevitable, but it becomes harder to reverse as the debt grows relative to the economy.
segments.tr: Hal itu tidak dapat dihindari, tetapi menjadi lebih sulit untuk dibalik seiring pertumbuhan utang terhadap perekonomian.

segments.src: **Political disagreement over the fix.** Analysts and policymakers differ on the response.
segments.tr: **Perbedaan pendapat politik mengenai solusinya.** Analis dan pembuat kebijakan berbeda pendapat dalam menanggapinya.

segments.src: Some emphasize spending restraint, others favor raising revenue, and others stress faster economic growth.
segments.tr: Beberapa menekankan pengekangan pengeluaran, yang lain mendukung peningkatan pendapatan, dan yang lain menekankan pertumbuhan ekonomi yang lebih cepat.

segments.src: Most nonpartisan analysts agree on one point: the arithmetic of rising interest costs makes the choices harder the longer they are postponed.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar analis nonpartisan sepakat pada satu hal: aritmatika biaya bunga yang meningkat membuat pilihan semakin sulit semakin lama ditunda.

segments.src: ## What it means for Treasury yields
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi imbal hasil Treasury

segments.src: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.
segments.tr: Imbal hasil Treasury adalah harga yang ditetapkan pasar untuk meminjamkan uang kepada pemerintah.

segments.src: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.
segments.tr: Mereka merespons ekspektasi tentang inflasi, kebijakan Fed, pertumbuhan ekonomi, dan pasokan utang baru.

segments.src: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.
segments.tr: Ketika pemerintah harus menjual sekuritas dalam jumlah besar, investor dapat menuntut imbal hasil yang lebih tinggi untuk menyerap pasokan tersebut, terutama untuk jangka waktu yang lebih lama.

segments.src: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.
segments.tr: Perdebatan mengenai kebijakan fiskal, kebuntuan batas utang, dan keputusan pemeringkatan kredit juga dapat menggerakkan pasar.

segments.src: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, imbal hasil yang lebih tinggi menaikkan biaya pinjaman pemerintah di masa mendatang, dan memengaruhi suku bunga hipotek, pinjaman mobil, dan utang korporasi.

segments.src: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.
segments.tr: Imbal hasil dipengaruhi oleh banyak faktor sekaligus, sehingga sulit untuk mengisolasi efek dari satu faktor saja.

segments.src: Treat any single-cause explanation of a yield move with caution.
segments.tr: Perlakukan penjelasan penyebab tunggal apa pun dari pergerakan imbal hasil dengan hati-hati.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi pajak dan layanan di masa mendatang

segments.src: Interest costs do not directly set tax policy, but they shape the options.
segments.tr: Biaya bunga tidak secara langsung menetapkan kebijakan pajak, tetapi biaya tersebut membentuk pilihannya.

segments.src: In broad terms, a government facing growing interest obligations can:
segments.tr: Secara garis besar, pemerintah yang menghadapi kewajiban bunga yang semakin besar dapat:

segments.src: 1. Raise revenue through taxes or fees.
segments.tr: 1. Meningkatkan pendapatan melalui pajak atau biaya.

segments.src: 2. Slow the growth of other spending.
segments.tr: 2. Memperlambat pertumbuhan pengeluaran lainnya.

segments.src: 3. Borrow more and accept higher interest costs.
segments.tr: 3. Meminjam lebih banyak dan menerima biaya bunga yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: 4. Rely on stronger economic growth to expand the tax base.
segments.tr: 4. Mengandalkan pertumbuhan ekonomi yang lebih kuat untuk memperluas basis pajak.

segments.src: In practice, governments usually use some mix.
segments.tr: Dalam praktiknya, pemerintah biasanya menggunakan beberapa kombinasi.

segments.src: Which mix to choose is a political decision, and reasonable people disagree.
segments.tr: Kombinasi mana yang akan dipilih adalah keputusan politik, dan orang-orang yang berpikiran sehat tidak akan selalu sepakat.

segments.src: What the numbers do show is that deferring the decision does not remove the cost.
segments.tr: Apa yang ditunjukkan oleh angka-angka tersebut adalah bahwa menunda keputusan tidak menghilangkan biayanya.

segments.src: ## Key takeaways
segments.tr: ## Poin penting

segments.src: - Net interest has become one of the largest federal budget categories, at roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates.
segments.tr: - Bunga bersih telah menjadi salah satu kategori anggaran federal terbesar, dengan perkiraan terbaru mencapai sekitar $1 triliun per tahun.

segments.src: - The increase comes from both a larger debt and higher interest rates, with refinancing spreading the effect over several years.
segments.tr: - Konsekuensi kenaikan berasal dari utang yang lebih besar dan suku bunga yang lebih tinggi, dengan pembiayaan kembali menyebarkan efeknya selama beberapa tahun.

segments.src: - Interest spending is less flexible than most other parts of the budget.
segments.tr: - Pengeluaran bunga kurang fleksibel dibandingkan sebagian besar bagian anggaran lainnya.

segments.src: - Treasury yields, deficits and fiscal debates influence one another.
segments.tr: - Imbal hasil Treasury, defisit, dan perdebatan fiskal saling memengaruhi satu sama lain.

segments.src: - Future tax and spending choices will be made against this backdrop.
segments.tr: - Pilihan pajak dan pengeluaran di masa mendatang akan dibuat dengan latar belakang ini.

segments.src: ## Where to find reliable data
segments.tr: ## Di mana menemukan data yang dapat diandalkan

segments.src: For current figures, consult primary sources: the Congressional Budget Office's budget and economic outlook, the Treasury Department's Monthly Treasury Statement and Fiscal Data site, and the Office of Management and Budget.
segments.tr: Untuk angka saat ini, konsultasikan dengan sumber primer: prospek anggaran dan ekonomi Kantor Anggaran Kongres, situs Pernyataan Keuangan Bulanan dan Data Fiskal Departemen Keuangan, serta Kantor Manajemen dan Anggaran.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk informasi umum dan edukasi.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice, and figures are approximate and may change as new data is released.*
segments.tr: *Ini bukan nasihat investasi, pajak, atau keuangan, dan angka-angka tersebut bersifat perkiraan serta dapat berubah seiring dirilisnya data baru.*

ja.title: 利払い費の増大：ワシントンの債務支払額がなぜ最大の予算項目に匹敵するようになったのか

segments.src: For decades, interest on the national debt was a line item most Americans never thought about.
segments.tr: 数十年にわたり、国債の利払いはほとんどのアメリカ人が気に留めない項目でした。

segments.src: That is changing.
segments.tr: それが変わりつつあります。

segments.src: Net interest, the amount the federal government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, has climbed to roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates from the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Treasury Department.
segments.tr: 純利払い（連邦政府が受け取る利息を差し引いた後の、借入に対する支払額）は、議会予算局（CBO）と財務省の最近の試算によると、年間約1兆ドルにまで上昇しています。

segments.src: That puts it in the same league as Medicare and national defense, and well above many programs that dominate budget debates.
segments.tr: これはメディケア（高齢者向け医療保険）や国防費と同水準であり、予算論争の的となる多くのプログラムを大きく上回っています。

segments.src: This explainer walks through why the bill has grown, how it works, and what it could mean for budget negotiations, Treasury yields and long-term fiscal choices.
segments.tr: 本解説では、なぜ利払い費が増大したのか、その仕組み、そして予算交渉、財務省証券の利回り、長期的な財政選択にとってそれが何を意味するのかを説明します。

segments.src: ## What "interest on the debt" actually means
segments.tr: ## 「国債の利払い」が実際に意味すること

segments.src: The federal government borrows by selling Treasury securities: short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: 連邦政府は、短期国庫証券、中期国債、長期国債といった財務省証券を売却することで資金を借り入れています。

segments.src: Investors, including pension funds, banks, foreign governments, mutual funds and individuals, buy them and receive interest payments.
segments.tr: 年金基金、銀行、外国政府、投資信託、個人などの投資家がこれらを購入し、利息を受け取ります。

segments.src: Two figures are often mixed up:
segments.tr: 2つの数字が混同されることがよくあります：

segments.src: - **Gross interest** is everything the government pays on all outstanding debt, including debt held by other parts of the government, such as trust funds.
segments.tr: - **グロス利払い（Gross interest）**は、信託基金など政府の他の部門が保有する債務を含め、すべての未償還債務に対して政府が支払う全額です。

segments.src: - **Net interest** subtracts interest the government receives, and it is the figure most budget analysts track because it reflects the real claim on the budget.
segments.tr: - **純利払い（Net interest）**は、政府が受け取る利息を差し引いたもので、予算に対する真の負担を反映しているため、ほとんどの予算アナリストが追跡している数字です。

segments.src: Either way, the number has grown quickly in recent years, both in dollars and as a share of the economy and of federal spending.
segments.tr: いずれにせよ、この数字は近年、金額ベースでも、経済や連邦支出に占める割合としても急速に増加しています。

segments.src: ## Two forces behind the rise
segments.tr: ## 上昇の背後にある2つの要因

segments.src: ### 1. A bigger pile of debt
segments.tr: ### 1. 債務残高の拡大

segments.src: Federal debt held by the public has grown substantially over the past two decades.
segments.tr: 公的部門が保有する連邦債務は、過去20年間で大幅に増加しました。

segments.src: Recessions, the 2020 pandemic response, tax changes and the rising costs of an aging population have all contributed.
segments.tr: 景気後退、2020年のパンデミック対応、税制変更、そして高齢化に伴うコストの上昇がすべて寄与しています。

segments.src: Because the government has generally run annual deficits, new borrowing keeps adding to the base on which interest is charged.
segments.tr: 政府は一般的に毎年赤字を計上しているため、新たな借入が利息の計算対象となる元本に積み重なっていきます。

segments.src: ### 2. Higher interest rates
segments.tr: ### 2. 金利の上昇

segments.src: For much of the 2010s, rates were historically low, so a large debt was relatively cheap to carry.
segments.tr: 2010年代の大部分において、金利は歴史的に低水準にあったため、多額の債務を抱えるコストは比較的安く済んでいました。

segments.src: When inflation surged in 2022, the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate sharply, and yields across the Treasury market rose with it.
segments.tr: 2022年にインフレが急騰した際、連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）は政策金利を大幅に引き上げ、それに伴い財務省証券市場全体の利回りも上昇しました。

segments.src: The effect does not show up all at once.
segments.tr: その影響は一度に現れるわけではありません。

segments.src: The Treasury continually refinances debt as older securities mature.
segments.tr: 財務省は、古い証券が満期を迎えるたびに継続的に債務を借り換えています。

segments.src: A bond issued at a low rate years ago is eventually replaced by one at today's higher rate, so the average rate on the whole debt drifts upward gradually.
segments.tr: 数年前に低金利で発行された債券は、最終的に今日の高金利の債券に置き換わるため、債務全体の平均金利は徐々に上昇していきます。

segments.src: This is why interest costs can keep rising even after rates stop climbing.
segments.tr: これが、金利の上昇が止まった後でも利払いコストが上昇し続ける理由です。

segments.src: Short-term bills are especially sensitive.
segments.tr: 短期国庫証券は特に敏感です。

segments.src: They roll over frequently, so changes in the Fed's policy rate feed through to the government's costs within months.
segments.tr: これらは頻繁に借り換えられるため、FRBの政策金利の変更は数ヶ月以内に政府のコストに反映されます。

segments.src: ## How the numbers compare
segments.tr: ## 数字の比較

segments.src: Net interest now exceeds what the government spends on national defense in several recent fiscal-year estimates, and it rivals or surpasses Medicaid and many other major categories.
segments.tr: 純利払いは、最近のいくつかの会計年度の試算では政府の国防支出を上回っており、メディケイド（低所得者向け医療保険）やその他の多くの主要な支出項目に匹敵するか、それを上回っています。

segments.src: The largest items, Social Security and Medicare, remain bigger.
segments.tr: 最大の項目である社会保障とメディケアは依然としてより大きな規模です。

segments.src: Still, interest differs from those programs in one important way: it is not a service Americans receive.
segments.tr: それでも、利払いはそれらのプログラムとは1つの重要な点で異なります。それは、アメリカ国民が受けるサービスではないということです。

segments.src: It is the cost of past borrowing, and it cannot be cut through ordinary program reforms.
segments.tr: それは過去の借入に対するコストであり、通常のプログラム改革では削減できません。

segments.src: Exact rankings vary by year and by how spending is categorized, so it is worth checking the latest CBO and Treasury data when you read a headline comparison.
segments.tr: 正確な順位は年や支出の分類方法によって異なるため、見出しの比較を読む際は最新のCBOや財務省のデータを確認することをお勧めします。

segments.src: ## Why it matters for budget fights
segments.tr: ## 予算争いにおいて重要な理由

segments.src: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.
segments.tr: **操作の余地が少ない。** 利払いに費やされる1ドルは、さらなる借入によって賄われない限り、道路、研究、国防、医療、減税に回すことができない1ドルです。

segments.src: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.
segments.tr: 年間支出法案を交渉する議員たちは、全体に占める裁量的経費のプールが縮小する中で、ますます厳しい対応を迫られています。

segments.src: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.
segments.tr: **フィードバックループ。** 利払いコストの上昇は赤字を拡大させ、さらなる借入を必要とし、それが将来の利払いコストを増加させます。

segments.src: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: 経済学者はこれを複利効果と呼ぶことがあります。

segments.src: It is not inevitable, but it becomes harder to reverse as the debt grows relative to the economy.
segments.tr: これは避けられないことではありませんが、経済規模に対して債務が増大するにつれて、逆転させることは困難になります。

segments.src: **Political disagreement over the fix.** Analysts and policymakers differ on the response.
segments.tr: **解決策をめぐる政治的対立。** アナリストや政策立案者の間でも対応策については意見が分かれています。

segments.src: Some emphasize spending restraint, others favor raising revenue, and others stress faster economic growth.
segments.tr: 支出の抑制を強調する者もいれば、増収を好む者、あるいはより速い経済成長を重視する者もいます。

segments.src: Most nonpartisan analysts agree on one point: the arithmetic of rising interest costs makes the choices harder the longer they are postponed.
segments.tr: 超党派の多くのアナリストが1つの点で合意しています。それは、利払いコスト上昇の計算上、先延ばしにすればするほど選択肢が難しくなるということです。

segments.src: ## What it means for Treasury yields
segments.tr: ## 財務省証券の利回りにとっての意味

segments.src: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.
segments.tr: 財務省証券の利回りは、市場が政府への貸し出しに対して設定する価格です。

segments.src: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.
segments.tr: これらは、インフレ、FRBの政策、経済成長、そして新規債務の供給に関する期待に反応します。

segments.src: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.
segments.tr: 政府が大量の証券を売却しなければならない場合、特に長期債において、投資家は供給を吸収するために高い利回りを要求する可能性があります。

segments.src: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.
segments.tr: 財政政策をめぐる議論、債務上限をめぐる膠着状態、信用格付けの決定も市場を動かす可能性があります。

segments.src: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.
segments.tr: 利回りの上昇は、結果として政府の将来の借入コストを引き上げ、住宅ローン、自動車ローン、企業債務の金利にも影響を与えます。

segments.src: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.
segments.tr: 利回りは多くの要因に同時に影響されるため、単一の要因の影響を切り離すことは困難です。

segments.src: Treat any single-cause explanation of a yield move with caution.
segments.tr: 利回りの変動に対する単一原因の説明には注意してください。

segments.src: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services
segments.tr: ## 将来の税金とサービスにとっての意味

segments.src: Interest costs do not directly set tax policy, but they shape the options.
segments.tr: 利払いコストは直接的に税制を決定するものではありませんが、選択肢を形作ります。

segments.src: In broad terms, a government facing growing interest obligations can:
segments.tr: 大まかに言えば、増大する利払い義務に直面している政府は、以下のことができます：

segments.src: 1. Raise revenue through taxes or fees.
segments.tr: 1. 税金や手数料を通じて歳入を増やす。

segments.src: 2. Slow the growth of other spending.
segments.tr: 2. 他の支出の伸びを抑制する。

segments.src: 3. Borrow more and accept higher interest costs.
segments.tr: 3. さらなる借入を行い、より高い利払いコストを受け入れる。

segments.src: 4. Rely on stronger economic growth to expand the tax base.
segments.tr: 4. より強力な経済成長に頼って税収基盤を拡大する。

segments.src: In practice, governments usually use some mix.
segments.tr: 実際には、政府は通常、これらを組み合わせて対応します。

segments.src: Which mix to choose is a political decision, and reasonable people disagree.
segments.tr: どの組み合わせを選ぶかは政治的な決定であり、合理的な人々の間でも意見が分かれます。

segments.src: What the numbers do show is that deferring the decision does not remove the cost.
segments.tr: 数字が示しているのは、決定を先延ばしにしてもコストはなくならないということです。

segments.src: ## Key takeaways
segments.tr: ## 主要なポイント

segments.src: - Net interest has become one of the largest federal budget categories, at roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates.
segments.tr: - 純利払いは、最近の試算で年間約1兆ドルに達し、連邦予算の最大の項目の一つとなっています。

segments.src: - The increase comes from both a larger debt and higher interest rates, with refinancing spreading the effect over several years.

de.title: Die Zinsrechnung wird fällig: Warum Washingtons Schuldenzahlungen inzwischen mit den größten Budgetposten konkurrieren

segments.src: For decades, interest on the national debt was a line item most Americans never thought about.
segments.tr: Jahrzehntelang waren die Zinsen auf die Staatsverschuldung ein Posten, über den die meisten Amerikaner nie nachdachten.

segments.src: That is changing.
segments.tr: Das ändert sich.

segments.src: Net interest, the amount the federal government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, has climbed to roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates from the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Treasury Department.
segments.tr: Die Nettozinsen – der Betrag, den die Bundesregierung nach Abzug der eingenommenen Zinsen für ihre Kreditaufnahme zahlt – sind nach jüngsten Schätzungen des Congressional Budget Office (CBO) und des Finanzministeriums auf rund 1 Billion US-Dollar pro Jahr gestiegen.

segments.src: That puts it in the same league as Medicare and national defense, and well above many programs that dominate budget debates.
segments.tr: Damit bewegen sie sich in derselben Liga wie Medicare und die Landesverteidigung und liegen weit über vielen Programmen, die Haushaltsdebatten dominieren.

segments.src: This explainer walks through why the bill has grown, how it works, and what it could mean for budget negotiations, Treasury yields and long-term fiscal choices.
segments.tr: Dieser Leitfaden erläutert, warum die Rechnung gewachsen ist, wie sie funktioniert und was sie für Haushaltsverhandlungen, Renditen von Staatsanleihen und langfristige fiskalische Entscheidungen bedeuten könnte.

segments.src: ## What "interest on the debt" actually means
segments.tr: ## Was "Zinsen auf die Schulden" tatsächlich bedeuten

segments.src: The federal government borrows by selling Treasury securities: short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: Die Bundesregierung nimmt Kredite auf, indem sie Staatspapiere verkauft: kurzfristige Bills, mittelfristige Notes und langfristige Bonds.

segments.src: Investors, including pension funds, banks, foreign governments, mutual funds and individuals, buy them and receive interest payments.
segments.tr: Investoren, darunter Pensionsfonds, Banken, ausländische Regierungen, Investmentfonds und Privatpersonen, kaufen diese und erhalten Zinszahlungen.

segments.src: Two figures are often mixed up:
segments.tr: Zwei Zahlen werden oft verwechselt:

segments.src: - **Gross interest** is everything the government pays on all outstanding debt, including debt held by other parts of the government, such as trust funds.
segments.tr: - **Bruttozinsen** sind alles, was die Regierung für die gesamte ausstehende Verschuldung zahlt, einschließlich der Schulden, die von anderen Teilen der Regierung wie Treuhandfonds gehalten werden.

segments.src: - **Net interest** subtracts interest the government receives, and it is the figure most budget analysts track because it reflects the real claim on the budget.
segments.tr: - **Nettozinsen** ziehen die Zinsen ab, die die Regierung erhält, und dies ist der Betrag, den die meisten Haushaltsanalysten verfolgen, da er den realen Anspruch an den Haushalt widerspiegelt.

segments.src: Either way, the number has grown quickly in recent years, both in dollars and as a share of the economy and of federal spending.
segments.tr: So oder so ist die Zahl in den letzten Jahren schnell gewachsen, sowohl in US-Dollar als auch als Anteil an der Wirtschaft und den Bundesausgaben.

segments.src: ## Two forces behind the rise
segments.tr: ## Zwei Kräfte hinter dem Anstieg

segments.src: ### 1. A bigger pile of debt
segments.tr: ### 1. Ein größerer Schuldenberg

segments.src: Federal debt held by the public has grown substantially over the past two decades.
segments.tr: Die von der Öffentlichkeit gehaltenen Staatsschulden sind in den letzten zwei Jahrzehnten erheblich gewachsen.

segments.src: Recessions, the 2020 pandemic response, tax changes and the rising costs of an aging population have all contributed.
segments.tr: Rezessionen, die Reaktion auf die Pandemie im Jahr 2020, Steueränderungen und die steigenden Kosten einer alternden Bevölkerung haben alle dazu beigetragen.

segments.src: Because the government has generally run annual deficits, new borrowing keeps adding to the base on which interest is charged.
segments.tr: Da die Regierung im Allgemeinen jährliche Defizite verzeichnet hat, erhöht eine neue Kreditaufnahme kontinuierlich die Basis, auf die Zinsen erhoben werden.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher interest rates
segments.tr: ### 2. Höhere Zinsen

segments.src: For much of the 2010s, rates were historically low, so a large debt was relatively cheap to carry.
segments.tr: Während eines Großteils der 2010er Jahre waren die Zinsen historisch niedrig, sodass ein großer Schuldenberg relativ günstig zu tragen war.

segments.src: When inflation surged in 2022, the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate sharply, and yields across the Treasury market rose with it.
segments.tr: Als die Inflation 2022 anstieg, hob die US-Notenbank ihren Leitzins drastisch an, und die Renditen am Markt für Staatspapiere stiegen damit.

segments.src: The effect does not show up all at once.
segments.tr: Die Auswirkung zeigt sich nicht auf einmal.

segments.src: The Treasury continually refinances debt as older securities mature.
segments.tr: Das Finanzministerium refinanziert Schulden kontinuierlich, wenn ältere Wertpapiere fällig werden.

segments.src: A bond issued at a low rate years ago is eventually replaced by one at today's higher rate, so the average rate on the whole debt drifts upward gradually.
segments.tr: Eine Anleihe, die vor Jahren zu einem niedrigen Zinssatz ausgegeben wurde, wird schließlich durch eine mit dem heutigen, höheren Zinssatz ersetzt, sodass der Durchschnittszins für die gesamte Verschuldung allmählich nach oben driftet.

segments.src: This is why interest costs can keep rising even after rates stop climbing.
segments.tr: Aus diesem Grund können die Zinskosten weiter steigen, selbst nachdem die Zinsen aufgehört haben zu klettern.

segments.src: Short-term bills are especially sensitive.
segments.tr: Kurzfristige Bills sind besonders empfindlich.

segments.src: They roll over frequently, so changes in the Fed's policy rate feed through to the government's costs within months.
segments.tr: Sie werden häufig erneuert, sodass sich Änderungen des Leitzinses der Notenbank innerhalb von Monaten auf die Kosten der Regierung auswirken.

segments.src: ## How the numbers compare
segments.tr: ## Wie sich die Zahlen vergleichen

segments.src: Net interest now exceeds what the government spends on national defense in several recent fiscal-year estimates, and it rivals or surpasses Medicaid and many other major categories.
segments.tr: Nettozinsen übersteigen in mehreren jüngsten Schätzungen für das Haushaltsjahr inzwischen die Summe, die die Regierung für die Landesverteidigung ausgibt, und sie rivalisieren mit oder übertreffen Medicaid und viele andere Hauptkategorien.

segments.src: The largest items, Social Security and Medicare, remain bigger.
segments.tr: Die größten Posten, Social Security und Medicare, bleiben größer.

segments.src: Still, interest differs from those programs in one important way: it is not a service Americans receive.
segments.tr: Dennoch unterscheiden sich Zinsen in einer wichtigen Hinsicht von diesen Programmen: Sie sind keine Dienstleistung, die Amerikaner erhalten.

segments.src: It is the cost of past borrowing, and it cannot be cut through ordinary program reforms.
segments.tr: Sie sind die Kosten vergangener Kreditaufnahmen und können nicht durch gewöhnliche Programmreformen gekürzt werden.

segments.src: Exact rankings vary by year and by how spending is categorized, so it is worth checking the latest CBO and Treasury data when you read a headline comparison.
segments.tr: Genaue Rankings variieren je nach Jahr und danach, wie Ausgaben kategorisiert werden, sodass es sich lohnt, die neuesten CBO- und Finanzministeriumsdaten zu prüfen, wenn man einen Überschriftenvergleich liest.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for budget fights
segments.tr: ## Warum es für Haushaltskämpfe wichtig ist

segments.src: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.
segments.tr: **Weniger Handlungsspielraum.** Jeder für Zinsen ausgegebene Dollar ist ein Dollar, der nicht für Straßen, Forschung, Verteidigung, Gesundheitsversorgung oder Steuererleichterungen zur Verfügung steht, es sei denn, er wird durch noch mehr Kreditaufnahmen finanziert.

segments.src: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.
segments.tr: Gesetzgeber, die über jährliche Haushaltsgesetze verhandeln, arbeiten zunehmend mit einem im Verhältnis zum Gesamtvolumen kleineren Pool an diskretionären Mitteln.

segments.src: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.
segments.tr: **Ein Rückkopplungseffekt.** Höhere Zinskosten vergrößern das Defizit, was mehr Kreditaufnahmen erfordert, was wiederum zu künftigen Zinskosten beiträgt.

segments.src: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: Ökonomen beschreiben dies manchmal als Zinseszinseffekt.

segments.src: It is not inevitable, but it becomes harder to reverse as the debt grows relative to the economy.
segments.tr: Er ist nicht unvermeidlich, aber er wird schwieriger umzukehren, je weiter die Verschuldung im Verhältnis zur Wirtschaft wächst.

segments.src: **Political disagreement over the fix.** Analysts and policymakers differ on the response.
segments.tr: **Politische Meinungsverschiedenheiten über die Lösung.** Analysten und Entscheidungsträger sind sich uneins über die Reaktion.

segments.src: Some emphasize spending restraint, others favor raising revenue, and others stress faster economic growth.
segments.tr: Einige betonen Ausgabenbeschränkungen, andere bevorzugen Einnahmensteigerungen, und wieder andere betonen schnelleres Wirtschaftswachstum.

segments.src: Most nonpartisan analysts agree on one point: the arithmetic of rising interest costs makes the choices harder the longer they are postponed.
segments.tr: Die meisten überparteilichen Analysten sind sich in einem Punkt einig: Die Arithmetik steigender Zinskosten macht die Entscheidungen umso schwieriger, je länger sie aufgeschoben werden.

segments.src: ## What it means for Treasury yields
segments.tr: ## Was es für die Renditen von Staatsanleihen bedeutet

segments.src: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.
segments.tr: Die Renditen von Staatspapieren sind die Preise, die der Markt für die Kreditvergabe an die Regierung festsetzt.

segments.src: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.
segments.tr: Sie reagieren auf Erwartungen hinsichtlich Inflation, Notenbankpolitik, Wirtschaftswachstum und dem Angebot an neuen Schulden.

segments.src: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.
segments.tr: Wenn die Regierung große Mengen an Wertpapieren verkaufen muss, verlangen Investoren möglicherweise höhere Renditen, um das Angebot aufzunehmen, insbesondere bei längeren Laufzeiten.

segments.src: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.
segments.tr: Debatten über die Fiskalpolitik, Auseinandersetzungen über die Schuldenobergrenze und Entscheidungen von Ratingagenturen können ebenfalls die Märkte bewegen.

segments.src: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.
segments.tr: Höhere Renditen wiederum treiben die künftigen Kreditkosten der Regierung nach oben und beeinflussen die Zinsen für Hypotheken, Autokredite und Unternehmensschulden.

segments.src: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.
segments.tr: Renditen werden von vielen Faktoren gleichzeitig beeinflusst, weshalb es schwierig ist, die Wirkung eines einzelnen Faktors zu isolieren.

segments.src: Treat any single-cause explanation of a yield move with caution.
segments.tr: Betrachten Sie jede einkausale Erklärung für eine Renditebewegung mit Vorsicht.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services
segments.tr: ## Was es für künftige Steuern und Dienstleistungen bedeuten könnte

segments.src: Interest costs do not directly set tax policy, but they shape the options.
segments.tr: Zinskosten legen die Steuerpolitik nicht direkt fest, aber sie prägen die Optionen.

segments.src: In broad terms, a government facing growing interest obligations can:
segments.tr: Im Großen und Ganzen kann eine Regierung, die mit wachsenden Zinsverpflichtungen konfrontiert ist, Folgendes tun:

segments.src: 1. Raise revenue through taxes or fees.
segments.tr: 1. Einnahmen durch Steuern oder Gebühren erhöhen.

segments.src: 2. Slow the growth of other spending.
segments.tr: 2. Das Wachstum anderer Ausgaben verlangsamen.

segments.src: 3. Borrow more and accept higher interest costs.
segments.tr: 3. Mehr Kredite aufnehmen und höhere Zinskosten akzeptieren.

segments.src: 4. Rely on stronger economic growth to expand the tax base.
segments.tr: 4. Auf ein stärkeres Wirtschaftswachstum setzen, um die Steuerbasis zu erweitern.

segments.src: In practice, governments usually use some mix.
segments.tr: In der Praxis verwenden Regierungen normalerweise eine Mischung aus diesen.

segments.src: Which mix to choose is a political decision, and reasonable people disagree.
segments.tr: Welche Mischung gewählt wird, ist eine politische Entscheidung, und vernünftige Menschen sind sich uneins.

segments.src: What the numbers do show is that deferring the decision does not remove the cost.
segments.tr: Was die Zahlen jedoch zeigen, ist, dass ein Aufschieben der Entscheidung die Kosten nicht beseitigt.

segments.src: ## Key takeaways
segments.tr: ## Die wichtigsten Erkenntnisse

segments.src: - Net interest has become one of the largest federal budget categories, at roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates.
segments.tr: - Nettozinsen sind zu einer der größten Haushaltskategorien des Bundes geworden, nach jüngsten Schätzungen rund 1 Billion US-Dollar pro Jahr.

segments.src: - The increase comes from both a larger debt and higher interest rates, with refinancing spreading the effect over several years.
segments.tr: - Der Anstieg resultiert sowohl aus einer größeren Verschuldung als auch aus höheren Zinsen, wobei Umschuldungen den Effekt über mehrere Jahre verteilen.

segments.src: - Interest spending is less flexible than most other parts of the budget.
segments.tr: - Zinsausgaben sind weniger flexibel als die meisten anderen Bereiche des Haushalts.

segments.src: - Treasury yields, deficits and fiscal debates influence one another.
segments.tr: - Renditen von Staatspapieren, Defizite und Haushaltsdebatten beeinflussen sich gegenseitig.

segments.src: - Future tax and spending choices will be made against this backdrop.
segments.tr: - Künftige Steuer- und Ausgabenentscheidungen werden vor diesem Hintergrund getroffen.

segments.src: ## Where to find reliable data
segments.tr: ## Wo man verlässliche Daten findet

segments.src: For current figures, consult primary sources: the Congressional Budget Office's budget and economic outlook, the Treasury Department's Monthly Treasury Statement and Fiscal Data site, and the Office of Management and Budget.
segments.tr: Konsultieren Sie für aktuelle Zahlen Primärquellen: den Haushalts- und Wirtschaftsausblick des Congressional Budget Office, das Monatsstatement des Finanzministeriums und dessen Website für Fiskaldaten sowie das Office of Management and Budget.

segments.tr: Lãi ròng, số tiền chính quyền liên bang trả cho các khoản vay của mình sau khi trừ đi khoản lãi kiếm được, đã tăng lên khoảng 1 nghìn tỷ đô la một năm theo các ước tính gần đây từ Văn phòng Ngân sách Quốc hội (CBO) và Bộ Ngân khố.

segments.src: That puts it in the same league as Medicare and national defense, and well above many programs that dominate budget debates.

segments.src: This explainer walks through why the bill has grown, how it works, and what it could mean for budget negotiations, Treasury yields and long-term fiscal choices.

segments.src: ## What "interest on the debt" actually means
segments.tr: ## Ý nghĩa thực sự của "tiền lãi trên khoản nợ"

segments.src: The federal government borrows by selling Treasury securities: short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: Chính phủ liên bang đi vay bằng cách bán chứng khoán Kho bạc: tín phiếu ngắn hạn, kỳ phiếu trung hạn và trái phiếu dài hạn.

segments.src: Investors, including pension funds, banks, foreign governments, mutual funds and individuals, buy them and receive interest payments.
segments.tr: Các nhà đầu tư, bao gồm quỹ hưu trí, ngân hàng, chính phủ nước ngoài, quỹ tương hỗ và cá nhân, mua chúng và nhận các khoản thanh toán lãi.

segments.src: Two figures are often mixed up:
segments.tr: Hai số liệu thường bị nhầm lẫn:

segments.src: - **Gross interest** is everything the government pays on all outstanding debt, including debt held by other parts of the government, such as trust funds.
segments.tr: - **Tổng lãi** là tất cả những gì chính phủ trả cho toàn bộ nợ chưa trả, bao gồm cả nợ do các bộ phận khác của chính phủ nắm giữ, chẳng hạn như các quỹ tín thác.

segments.src: - **Net interest** subtracts interest the government receives, and it is the figure most budget analysts track because it reflects the real claim on the budget.
segments.tr: - **Lãi ròng** trừ đi phần lãi mà chính phủ nhận được, và đây là số liệu mà hầu hết các nhà phân tích ngân sách theo dõi vì nó phản ánh yêu sách thực tế đối với ngân sách.

segments.src: Either way, the number has grown quickly in recent years, both in dollars and as a share of the economy and of federal spending.
segments.tr: Dù bằng cách nào, con số này đã tăng lên nhanh chóng trong những năm gần đây, cả về mặt đô la lẫn tỷ trọng trong nền kinh tế và chi tiêu liên bang.

segments.src: ## Two forces behind the rise
segments.tr: ## Hai lực lượng đằng sau sự gia tăng

segments.src: ### 1. A bigger pile of debt
segments.tr: ### 1. Khoảng nợ lớn hơn

segments.src: Federal debt held by the public has grown substantially over the past two decades.
segments.tr: Nợ liên bang do công chúng nắm giữ đã tăng đáng kể trong hai thập kỷ qua.

segments.src: Recessions, the 2020 pandemic response, tax changes and the rising costs of an aging population have all contributed.
segments.tr: Suy thoái kinh tế, phản ứng với đại dịch 2020, thay đổi thuế và chi phí gia tăng của dân số già hóa đều góp phần vào đó.

segments.src: Because the government has generally run annual deficits, new borrowing keeps adding to the base on which interest is charged.
segments.tr: Vì chính phủ thường thâm hụt hàng năm, các khoản vay mới tiếp tục cộng vào cơ sở tính lãi.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher interest rates
segments.tr: ### 2. Lãi suất cao hơn

segments.src: For much of the 2010s, rates were historically low, so a large debt was relatively cheap to carry.
segments.tr: Trong phần lớn những năm 2010, lãi suất ở mức thấp kỷ lục, vì vậy việc gánh một khoản nợ lớn tương đối rẻ.

segments.src: When inflation surged in 2022, the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate sharply, and yields across the Treasury market rose with it.
segments.tr: Khi lạm phát tăng vọt vào năm 2022, Cục Dự trữ Liên bang đã nâng mạnh lãi suất chuẩn, và lợi suất trên thị trường Kho bạc cũng tăng theo.

segments.src: The effect does not show up all at once.
segments.tr: Hiệu ứng không xuất hiện ngay lập tức.

segments.src: The Treasury continually refinances debt as older securities mature.
segments.tr: Bộ Ngân khố liên tục tái tài trợ nợ khi các chứng khoán cũ đáo hạn.

segments.src: A bond issued at a low rate years ago is eventually replaced by one at today's higher rate, so the average rate on the whole debt drifts upward gradually.
segments.tr: Một trái phiếu phát hành với lãi suất thấp nhiều năm trước cuối cùng được thay thế bằng trái phiếu có lãi suất cao hơn của ngày hôm nay, vì vậy lãi suất trung bình trên toàn bộ khoản nợ tăng dần từ từ.

segments.src: This is why interest costs can keep rising even after rates stop climbing.
segments.tr: Đây là lý do tại sao chi phí lãi có thể tiếp tục tăng ngay cả sau khi lãi suất ngừng tăng.

segments.src: Short-term bills are especially sensitive.
segments.tr: Tín phiếu ngắn hạn đặc biệt nhạy cảm.

segments.src: They roll over frequently, so changes in the Fed's policy rate feed through to the government's costs within months.
segments.tr: Chúng được đảo nợ thường xuyên, vì vậy những thay đổi trong lãi suất chính sách của Fed truyền dẫn đến chi phí của chính phủ trong vòng vài tháng.

segments.src: ## How the numbers compare
segments.tr: ## Các con số so sánh như thế nào

segments.src: Net interest now exceeds what the government spends on national defense in several recent fiscal-year estimates, and it rivals or surpasses Medicaid and many other major categories.
segments.tr: Lãi ròng hiện vượt mức chính phủ chi cho quốc phòng trong một số ước tính năm tài chính gần đây, và nó cạnh tranh hoặc vượt qua Medicaid cùng nhiều danh mục lớn khác.

segments.src: The largest items, Social Security and Medicare, remain bigger.
segments.tr: Các khoản mục lớn nhất, An sinh Xã hội và Medicare, vẫn lớn hơn.

segments.src: Still, interest differs from those programs in one important way: it is not a service Americans receive.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, tiền lãi khác với các chương trình đó ở một điểm quan trọng: nó không phải là một dịch vụ mà người Mỹ nhận được.

segments.src: It is the cost of past borrowing, and it cannot be cut through ordinary program reforms.
segments.tr: Nó là chi phí của việc vay mượn trong quá khứ và không thể cắt giảm thông qua các cải cách chương trình thông thường.

segments.src: Exact rankings vary by year and by how spending is categorized, so it is worth checking the latest CBO and Treasury data when you read a headline comparison.
segments.tr: Thứ hạng chính xác thay đổi theo năm và theo cách phân loại chi tiêu, vì vậy bạn nên kiểm tra dữ liệu mới nhất của CBO và Bộ Ngân khố khi đọc một tiêu đề so sánh.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for budget fights
segments.tr: ## Tại sao nó quan trọng đối với các cuộc đấu đá ngân sách

segments.src: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.
segments.tr: **Ít dư địa xoay sở hơn.** Mỗi đô la chi cho tiền lãi là một đô la không có sẵn cho đường sá, nghiên cứu, quốc phòng, chăm sóc sức khỏe hoặc giảm thuế, trừ khi được tài trợ bằng cách vay nhiều hơn nữa.

segments.src: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.
segments.tr: **Nhà lập pháp** đàm phán các dự luật chi tiêu hàng năm ngày càng làm việc với quỹ tùy ý nhỏ hơn so với tổng số.

segments.src: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.
segments.tr: **Một vòng lặp phản hồi.** Chi phí lãi cao hơn làm trầm trọng thêm thâm hụt, đòi hỏi phải vay nhiều hơn, điều này làm tăng chi phí lãi trong tương lai.

segments.src: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: Các nhà kinh tế đôi khi mô tả đây là hiệu ứng kép.

segments.src: It is not inevitable, but it becomes harder to reverse as the debt grows relative to the economy.
segments.tr: Nó không phải là không thể tránh khỏi, nhưng việc đảo ngược trở nên khó khăn hơn khi nợ tăng lên so với nền kinh tế.

segments.src: **Political disagreement over the fix.** Analysts and policymakers differ on the response.
segments.tr: **Bất đồng chính trị về giải pháp.** Các nhà phân tích và nhà hoạch định chính sách có phản ứng khác nhau.

segments.src: Some emphasize spending restraint, others favor raising revenue, and others stress faster economic growth.
segments.tr: Một số nhấn mạnh kiềm chế chi tiêu, những người khác ủng hộ tăng doanh thu, và những người khác nhấn mạnh tăng trưởng kinh tế nhanh hơn.

segments.src: Most nonpartisan analysts agree on one point: the arithmetic of rising interest costs makes the choices harder the longer they are postponed.
segments.tr: Hầu hết các nhà phân tích độc lập đều đồng ý về một điểm: toán học của việc tăng chi phí lãi làm cho các lựa chọn trở nên khó khăn hơn càng trì hoãn lâu.

segments.src: ## What it means for Treasury yields
segments.tr: **Ý nghĩa đối với lợi suất Kho bạc**

segments.src: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.
segments.tr: Lợi suất Kho bạc là mức giá mà thị trường thiết lập cho việc cho chính phủ vay.

segments.src: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.
segments.tr: Chúng phản ứng với kỳ vọng về lạm phát, chính sách của Fed, tăng trưởng kinh tế và nguồn cung nợ mới.

segments.src: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.
segments.tr: Khi chính phủ phải bán một lượng lớn chứng khoán, nhà đầu tư có thể yêu cầu lợi suất cao hơn để hấp thụ nguồn cung, đặc biệt là đối với các kỳ hạn dài hơn.

segments.src: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.
segments.tr: Các cuộc tranh luận về chính sách tài khóa, bế tắc giới hạn nợ và các quyết định xếp hạng tín dụng cũng có thể làm rung chuyển thị trường.

segments.src: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.
segments.tr: Lợi suất cao hơn, đổi lại, làm tăng chi phí vay trong tương lai của chính phủ, và chúng ảnh hưởng đến lãi suất thế chấp, cho vay ô tô và nợ doanh nghiệp.

segments.src: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.
segments.tr: Lợi suất bị ảnh hưởng bởi nhiều yếu tố cùng một lúc, vì vậy rất khó để tách biệt tác động của bất kỳ yếu tố đơn lẻ nào.

segments.src: Treat any single-cause explanation of a yield move with caution.
segments.tr: Hãy thận trọng với bất kỳ lời giải thích một nguyên nhân nào về việc biến động lợi suất.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services
segments.tr: ## Ý nghĩa đối với thuế và dịch vụ trong tương lai

segments.src: Interest costs do not directly set tax policy, but they shape the options.
segments.tr: Chi phí lãi không trực tiếp thiết lập chính sách thuế, nhưng chúng định hình các lựa chọn.

segments.src: In broad terms, a government facing growing interest obligations can:
segments.tr: Nói chung, một chính phủ đối mặt với nghĩa vụ lãi gia tăng có thể:

segments.src: 1. Raise revenue through taxes or fees.
segments.tr: 1. Tăng doanh thu thông qua thuế hoặc phí.

segments.src: 2. Slow the growth of other spending.
segments.tr: 2. Làm chậm sự tăng trưởng của các khoản chi tiêu khác.

segments.src: 3. Borrow more and accept higher interest costs.
segments.tr: 3. Vay nhiều hơn và chấp nhận chi phí lãi cao hơn.

segments.src: 4. Rely on stronger economic growth to expand the tax base.
segments.tr: 4. Dựa vào tăng trưởng kinh tế mạnh mẽ hơn để mở rộng cơ sở thuế.

segments.src: In practice, governments usually use some mix.
segments.tr: Trong thực tế, các chính phủ thường sử dụng sự kết hợp nào đó.

segments.src: Which mix to choose is a political decision, and reasonable people disagree.
segments.tr: Lựa chọn sự kết hợp nào là một quyết định chính trị, và những người có lý trí không đồng tình.

segments.src: What the numbers do show is that deferring the decision does not remove the cost.
segments.tr: Những con số cho thấy việc trì hoãn quyết định không làm mất đi chi phí.

segments.src: ## Key takeaways
segments.tr: ## Điểm chính cần ghi nhớ

segments.src: - Net interest has become one of the largest federal budget categories, at roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates.
segments.tr: - Lãi ròng đã trở thành một trong những danh mục ngân sách liên bang lớn nhất, ở mức khoảng 1 nghìn tỷ đô la một năm theo các ước tính gần đây.

segments.src: - The increase comes from both a larger debt and higher interest rates, with refinancing spreading the effect over several years.
segments.tr: - Sự gia tăng đến từ cả khoản nợ lớn hơn và lãi suất cao hơn, với việc tái tài trợ phân bổ tác động trong vài năm.

segments.src: - Interest spending is less flexible than most other parts of the budget.
segments.tr: - Chi tiêu cho lãi ít linh hoạt hơn hầu hết các phần khác của ngân sách.

segments.src: - Treasury yields, deficits and fiscal debates influence one another.
segments.tr: - Lợi suất Kho bạc, thâm hụt và các cuộc tranh luận tài khóa ảnh hưởng lẫn nhau.

segments.src: - Future tax and spending choices will be made against this backdrop.
segments.tr: - Các lựa chọn thuế và chi tiêu trong tương lai sẽ được thực hiện trong bối cảnh này.

segments.src: ## Where to find reliable data
segments.tr: ## Nơi tìm dữ liệu đáng tin cậy

segments.src: For current figures, consult primary sources: the Congressional Budget Office's budget and economic outlook, the Treasury Department's Monthly Treasury Statement and Fiscal Data site, and the Office of Management and Budget.
segments.tr: Đối với các số liệu hiện tại, hãy tham khảo các nguồn chính: triển vọng ngân sách và kinh tế của Văn phòng Ngân sách Quốc hội, trang Tuyên bố Ngân sách Hàng tháng và Dữ liệu Tài chính của Bộ Ngân khố, và Văn phòng Quản lý và Ngân sách.
